jobs.description:
Job Profile: IT Service Delivery – Team Lead
 Department: COO – IT / IT Service Delivery
 Location: Geneva – On-site (not hybrid)
 Job Type: Full-Time (Permanent)
 Reports To: Head of IT Service Management
 Date: 01.08.2026
 Job Summary

• The IT Service Delivery – Team Lead is responsible for managing the daily operations and governance of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes within UBP, with a focus on Incident, Problem, Change and Vulnerability Management, the ITSM tool (Jira Service Management) and CMDB governance.

• The role ensures a high quality of service to end users and senior management, guarantees strict adherence to ITSM and Vulnerability Management processes, and contributes to the continuous improvement of IT Service Delivery within the Bank.

• Beyond process ownership, the role contributes directly to the continuity of the Bank’s business activities by reducing the impact of IT incidents on the business and improving the overall user experience. The Team Lead acts as a key ITSM reference within IT, steering processes in a data‑driven way and collaborating closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Risk and business stakeholders.

• Key Responsibilities

• IT Incident Management:

• Coordinate and oversee the end‑to‑end IT Incident Management process.

• Ensure timely, clear and audience‑appropriate communication and reporting on IT incidents to end users, IT management and business stakeholders.

• Monitor incident trends, identify recurring issues and propose corrective and preventive actions.

• Ensure that SLAs, regulatory requirements (including DORA) and internal quality standards are met.

• Measure and improve user satisfaction (e.g. post‑incident surveys, CSAT) and minimize business impact and downtime for critical services.

• IT Problem Management:

• Coordinate and oversee IT Problem Management activities.

• Facilitate root cause analysis, ensure appropriate documentation of known errors and maintain a robust Known Error Database.

• Communicate and report on IT problems to IT stakeholders, with a more technical audience than Incident Management.

• Follow up on action plans to prevent recurrence of major incidents and track their effectiveness over time.

• Maintain close communication with the Service Desk to detect patterns and emerging issues, leveraging ITSM data and trends to prioritize high‑impact problems.

• IT Change Management:

• Lead the IT Change Management process: risk assessment, validation, presentation and follow‑up of all IT changes in production.

• Ensure strict adherence to IT Change processes to protect the Bank against undeclared or incorrectly assessed changes.

• Chair or actively participate in Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and ensure proper documentation and communication of decisions.

• Monitor change KPIs (success rate, back‑out rate, incidents related to changes) and drive continuous improvement.

• Align the Change Management process with Agile / DevOps practices used by development and infrastructure teams, while maintaining compliance, stability and security.

• Vulnerability Management:

• Oversee the end‑to‑end Vulnerability Management process in coordination with Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams.

• Ensure regular vulnerability scanning, assessment and prioritisation based on risk and business impact.

• Coordinate remediation plans, track progress and escalate when deadlines or risk thresholds are not met.

• Ensure alignment between Vulnerability Management and Incident, Problem and Change processes (e.g. remediation via standard or emergency changes).

• ITSM Tool Ownership:

• Act as process owner for the ITSM tool used by all IT users to log incidents, changes, problems, requests and work orders.

• Manage the lifecycle of the platform, including evolution requests, configuration changes and daily operational tasks.

• Ensure data quality, consistency of categories and a user‑friendly experience within the tool.

• Define and evolve the ITSM data model (ticket types, workflows, mandatory fields) to support reporting, audit and continuous improvement needs.

• Promote automation (routing, notifications, integrations with other tools) to improve operational efficiency.

• Oversee the quality, completeness and accuracy of configuration data used in Incident, Change and Vulnerability Management processes.

• Propose and follow up on areas of improvement for CMDB structure, processes and controls.

• Coordinate with infrastructure and application teams to maintain accurate relationships and dependencies between configuration items.

Tipo di lavoro - tempo pieno (manente)

Data - 01.08.2026

Sintesi del lavoro - La fornitura di servizi IT. Team Lead è responsabile della gestione quotidiana delle operazioni e della governance dei processi IT Service Management (ITSM) all'interno di UBP, con un focus su Incidente, Problema, Cambiamento e Vulnerabilità Management, lo strumento ISM (Jira Service Management) e la governance CMDB. - Il ruolo assicura un'alta qualità del servizio agli utenti finali e all'alta dirigenza, garantisce una stretta aderenza ai processi di gestione di ISM e Vulnerability Management e contribuisce al continuo miglioramento della fornitura di servizi IT all'interno della Banca.

- Oltre alla proprietà dei processi, il ruolo contribuisce direttamente alla continuità delle attività della Banca, riducendo l'impatto degli incidenti informatici sull'impresa e migliorando l'esperienza complessiva degli utenti. Il Team Lead funge da riferimento chiave per l'ITSM nell'ambito dell'IT, guidando i processi in modo basato sui dati e collaborando strettamente con gli stakeholder IT, Cybersecurity, Risk e business.

Responsabilità chiave

Gestione degli incidenti informatici - Coordinare e supervisionare il processo di gestione degli incidenti informatici end-to-end. - Garantire una comunicazione tempestiva, chiara e adeguata al pubblico e la comunicazione degli incidenti informatici agli utenti finali, alla gestione delle tecnologie dell'informazione e alle parti interessate. - Monitorare le tendenze degli incidenti, individuare le questioni ricorrenti e proporre azioni correttive e preventive. - Garantire il rispetto degli SLA, dei requisiti normativi (compreso DORA) e degli standard di qualità interni. - Misurare e migliorare la soddisfazione degli utenti (ad esempio indagini post-incidente, CSAT) e ridurre al minimo l'impatto delle imprese e i tempi di fermo per i servizi critici.

Gestione dei problemi IT - Coordinare e supervisionare le attività di gestione dei problemi IT. - Facilitare l'analisi delle cause root, garantire un'adeguata documentazione degli errori noti e mantenere un solido database degli errori conosciuti. - Comunicare e riferire sui problemi IT agli stakeholder IT, con un pubblico più tecnico di Incident Management. - Seguire i piani d'azione per prevenire la reiterazione di incidenti gravi e monitorare la loro efficacia nel tempo. - Mantenere una stretta comunicazione con il Service Desk per individuare modelli e questioni emergenti, sfruttando i dati e le tendenze dell'ITSM per dare priorità ai problemi di impatto elevato.

Gestione dei cambiamenti IT - Guidare il processo di gestione dei cambiamenti IT: valutazione dei rischi, convalida, presentazione e follow-up di tutte le modifiche IT nella produzione. - Garantire la stretta adesione ai processi di cambiamento IT per proteggere la Banca da cambiamenti non dichiarati o valutati in modo errato. - Presidente o partecipare attivamente ai comitati consultivi sui cambiamenti (CAB) e garantire una documentazione e una comunicazione adeguate delle decisioni. - Monitorare i cambiamenti KPI (tasso di success, tasso di back-out, incidenti legati ai cambiamenti) e guidare il miglioramento continuo.

- Allineare il processo di Gestione del Cambiamento con le pratiche Agile / DevOps utilizzate dai team di sviluppo e infrastruttura, mantenendo nel contempo la conformità, la stabilità e la sicurezza.

Gestione della vulnerabilità - Superare il processo di gestione della vulnerabilità end-to-end in coordinamento con i team Cybersecurity e Infrastructure. - Garantire la scansione, la valutazione e la priorità delle vulnerabilità in base al rischio e all'impatto delle imprese. - Coordinare i piani di risanamento, monitorare i progressi e aumentare quando non sono soddisfatte scadenze o soglie di rischio. - Garantire l'allineamento tra i processi di gestione della vulnerabilità e di incidente, problema e cambiamento (ad esempio, la bonifica tramite modifiche standard o di emergenza).

Proprietà degli strumenti ITSM - Agisce come proprietario del processo per lo strumento ITSM utilizzato da tutti gli utenti IT per registrare incidenti, modifiche, problemi, richieste e ordini di lavoro. - Gestire il ciclo di vita della piattaforma, comprese richieste di evoluzione, modifiche di configurazione e attività operative quotidiane. - Coordinare con team tecnici per aggiornamenti, integrazioni e miglioramenti delle prestazioni. - Garantire la qualità dei dati, la coerenza delle categorie e un'esperienza user-friendly all'interno dello strumento. - Definire ed evolvere il modello dati ITSM (tipo di ticket, flussi di lavoro, campi obbligatori) per supportare le esigenze di reporting, audit e miglioramento continuo.

- Promuovere l'automazione (rotta, notifiche, integrazioni con altri strumenti) per migliorare l'efficienza operativa.

Governance CMDB - Assicurate l'implementazione della strategia CMDB definita dall'alta dirigenza. - Sorvegliate la qualità, la completezza e l'accuratezza dei dati di configurazione utilizzati nei processi di Gestione degli incidenti, cambiamenti e vulnerabilità. - Proporre e seguire le aree di miglioramento per la struttura, i processi e i controlli CMDB. - Coordinare con i team di infrastruttura e applicazione per mantenere relazioni e dipendenze accurate tra elementi di configurazione.

- Implementa controlli regolari sulla qualità dei dati (rencorizzazioni, audit, KPI sulla completezza e correttezza) e assicura l'integrazione del CMDB con altri strumenti (monitoraggio, gestione delle vulnerabilità, gestione degli asset).

Gestione dei processi e della qualità - Standardizzare e migliorare continuamente i processi di fornitura dei servizi IT in linea con le best practice ITIL. - Definire, tracciare e segnalare KPI e metriche relative a Incidente, Problema, Cambiamento, Gestione delle vulnerabilità, utilizzo degli strumenti ISM e qualità CMDB. - Sviluppare dashboard e rapporti regolari per i comitati di gestione e governance IT, utilizzando ISM e i relativi dati per supportare il processo decisionale. - Contribuire a verificare la prontezza e la conformità dei processi di gestione dei servizi IT e di gestione delle vulnerabilità (audit interni ed esterni).

- Promuovere una cultura dell'eccellenza dei servizi, dell'attenzione al cliente e del miglioramento continuo all'interno del team e attraverso le tecnologie dell'informazione. - Lead post-infortuning reviews (PIR) e modificare le revisioni per identificare le lezioni apprese e guidare azioni correttive e preventive.

Team Leadership - Leader, coach e sviluppo del Service Delivery membri del team, compresa la gestione delle prestazioni e lo sviluppo delle competenze. - Organizzare carico di lavoro, priorità e accordi di servizio/servizio, ove applicabile. - Promuovere la collaborazione con altri team IT (infrastrutture, sviluppo, sicurezza) e stakeholder aziendali. - Garantire una comunicazione chiara e trasparente all'interno del team e con la gestione. - Sviluppare capacità del team in ITIL, strumenti ISM, comunicazione e gestione delle crisi attraverso i corsi di coaching, mentoring e piani di formazione.

- Gestire incidenti e situazioni di crisi rilevanti garantendo un coordinamento, una priorità e una comunicazione efficaci. - Promuovere una cultura collaborativa, inclusiva e responsabile del team.

Competenze e qualifiche

Istruzione - Liceo / Maturité / Baccalauréat o laurea in Informatica, Informatica o un campo correlato.

Capacità tecniche - Richiesta di certificazione ITIL (o quadro equivalente di gestione dei servizi IT) - Una solida esperienza con gli strumenti ITSM e i concetti CMDB, idealmente Jira Service Management. - Buona comprensione dell'infrastruttura IT e degli ambienti applicativi in un contesto bancario. - L'esperienza con i processi e gli strumenti di Vulnerability Management (ad esempio vulnerabilità di scanner, dashboard, workflow di bonifica) è un bene forte. - Capacità di costruire e interpretare ITSM e dashboard operativi (ad esempio utilizzando reporting integrato, strumenti BI) e utilizzare i dati per guidare le decisioni.

Esperienza - 5,7 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei servizi IT o un ruolo simile (livello di gestione intermedia). - Esperienza nel settore finanziario: obbligatoria. - Esperienza di proven nella gestione dei processi di incidente, problema e cambiamento e/o nella guida di un team di Service Delivery. - L'esperienza di lavoro con team di sicurezza / cyber su temi di vulnerabilità o gestione del rischio è un vantaggio. - Esperienza dimostrativa nella gestione di incidenti gravi e comunicazione con gli stakeholder senior durante le crisi.

Soft Skills - Forte capacità comunicative (orali e scritte), con la capacità di spiegare argomenti tecnici a pubblico non tecnico e di comunicare chiaramente sotto pressione. - Clienti e servizi orientati alla mente, con una forte priorità e capacità di negoziazione. - Capacità di gestire lo stress e prendere decisioni sane in situazioni di alta pressione (ad esempio incidenti di rilievo). - Capacità di influenzare senza autorità gerarchica diretta e di costruire relazioni forti tra IT, Cybersecurity, Rischio e team aziendali.

- Approccio strutturato, analitico e basato sui dati alla soluzione dei problemi e al miglioramento continuo.

Lingue - Francese: Fluent. - Inglese: Fluent.

Ambiente di lavoro - Posizione con sede a Ginevra, in un contesto bancario internazionale. - Interazioni frequenti con squadre multi-site e interfunzionali (IT, Cybersecurity, Risk, business lines). - La partecipazione alle rotazioni di servizio/servizio può essere richiesta in funzione delle esigenze operative.

Altro - Residenza svizzera Obbligatorio

Core Competence - Aderenza ai valori aziendali: Dedicazione, Convinzione, Agiltà e Responsabilità - Rispetto delle normative e delle direttive interne

Jobprofil: IT Service Delivery – Team Lead

Abteilung - COO – IT / IT Service Lieferung

Standort - Genf – Vor-Ort (nicht Hybrid)

Jobtyp - Vollzeit (Permanent)

Berichte an - Leiter IT Service Management

Datum - 01.08.2026

Job Summary - The IT Service Delivery – Team Lead ist verantwortlich für die Verwaltung des täglichen Betriebs und die Steuerung der IT Service Management (ITSM) Prozesse innerhalb der UBP, mit einem Fokus auf Incident, Problem, Change und Vulnerability Management, das ITSM Tool (Jira Service Management) und CMDB Governance. - Die Rolle gewährleistet eine hohe Qualität der Service für Endnutzer und Senior Management, garantiert eine strikte Einhaltung von ITSM und Vulnerability Management Prozesse, und trägt zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der IT Service Delivery innerhalb der Bank.

- Neben der Prozessverantwortung trägt die Rolle direkt zur Kontinuität der Geschäftsaktivitäten der Bank bei, indem sie die Auswirkungen von IT-Vorfällen auf das Geschäft reduziert und die Gesamterfahrung der Nutzer verbessert. Das Team Lead fungiert als zentraler ITSM-Referenzpunkt innerhalb der IT, steuert Prozesse datengesteuert und arbeitet eng mit IT, Cybersecurity, Risk und Business Stakeholdern zusammen.

Wichtige Aufgaben

IT-Inzidenzmanagement - koordiniert und überwacht den End-to-End-Inzidenzmanagement-Prozess. - Gewährleistung einer zeitnahen, klaren und publikumsgerechten Kommunikation und Berichterstattung über IT-Vorfälle an Endnutzer, IT-Management und Business-Stakeholder. - Überwachung von Ereignistrends, Ermittlung wiederkehrender Probleme und Vorschlag von Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen. - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von SLAs, regulatorischen Anforderungen (einschließlich DORA) und internen Qualitätsstandards. - Messung und Verbesserung der Nutzerzufriedenheit (z.B. nach-Inzidenz-Umfragen, CSAT) und Minimierung der Geschäftsauswirkungen und Ausfallzeiten für kritische Dienste.

IT-Problemmanagement - Koordination und Überwachung der IT-Problemmanagement-Aktivitäten. - Facilitate root cause analysis, sicherzustellen, dass bekannte Fehler angemessen dokumentiert werden und eine robuste bekannte Fehlerdatenbank. - Kommunikation und Bericht über IT-Probleme an IT-Stakeholder, mit einem mehr technischen Publikum als Incident Management. - Folgemaßnahmen zu Aktionsplänen, um Wiederholungen von Großereignissen zu verhindern und ihre Wirksamkeit im Laufe der Zeit zu verfolgen. - Pflege einer engen Kommunikation mit dem Service Desk, um Muster und neu auftretende Probleme zu erkennen, und Nutzung von ITSM-Daten und Trends, um hochwirksame Probleme zu priorisieren.

IT Change Management - Führen des IT Change Management Prozesses: Risikobewertung, Validierung, Präsentation und Follow-up aller IT-Änderungen in der Produktion. - Gewährleistung der strikten Einhaltung von IT Change Prozessen zum Schutz der Bank vor nicht angemeldeten oder falsch bewerteten Änderungen. - Vorsitzender oder aktiv an Change Advisory Boards (CAB) teilnehmen und eine ordnungsgemäße Dokumentation und Kommunikation von Entscheidungen. - Überwachung der Änderung KPIs (Erfolgsrate, Sicherungsrate, Ereignisse im Zusammenhang mit Änderungen) und Antrieb kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

- Richten Sie den Change Management Prozess mit Agile / DevOps Praktiken von Entwicklungs-und Infrastruktur-Teams verwendet, unter Beibehaltung der Einhaltung, Stabilität und Sicherheit.

Sicherheitsmanagement - Überwachen Sie den End-to-End-Prozess des Sicherheitsmanagements in Abstimmung mit Cybersecurity- und Infrastrukturteams. - Gewährleistung eines regelmäßigen Sicherheitsscans, einer Bewertung und Priorisierung auf der Grundlage von Risiko- und Geschäftseffekten. - Koordinierung von Sanierungsplänen, Verfolgung von Fortschritten und Eskalation, wenn Fristen oder Risikoschwellen nicht eingehalten werden. - Gewährleistung einer Abstimmung zwischen Sicherheitsmanagement und Prozessen des Vorfalls, Problem- und Änderungsprozessen (z.B. Sanierung über Standard- oder Notfalländerungen).

ITSM Tool Ownership - Handeln Sie als Prozessinhaber für das ITSM Tool, das von allen IT-Nutzern verwendet wird, um Vorfälle, Änderungen, Probleme, Anfragen und Arbeitsaufträge zu protokollieren. - Verwalten Sie den Lebenszyklus der Plattform, einschließlich Evolutionswünsche, Konfigurationsänderungen und tägliche operative Aufgaben. - Koordinieren Sie mit technischen Teams für Upgrades, Integrationen und Leistungsverbesserungen. - Sicherstellen Sie die Datenqualität, die Konsistenz der Kategorien und eine benutzerfreundliche Erfahrung innerhalb des Tools. - Definieren und entwickeln Sie das ITSM Datenmodell (Vikture-Typen, Workflows, Pflichtfelder) um die Berichterstattung, Audit und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsanforderungen zu unterstützen.

- Förderung der Automatisierung (Routing, Benachrichtigungen, Integration mit anderen Werkzeugen) zur Verbesserung der Betriebseffizienz.

CMDB Governance - Sicherstellen, dass die CMDB-Strategie von Senior Management definiert. - Überwachen Sie die Qualität, Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Konfigurationsdaten in Incident, Change und Vulnerability Management Prozesse verwendet. - Propose and follow up in Bereichen der Verbesserung für CMDB-Struktur, Prozesse und Kontrollen. - Koordinieren Sie mit Infrastruktur und Anwendungsteams, um genaue Beziehungen und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Konfigurationselementen zu halten.

- Regelmäßige Datenqualitätskontrollen (Ausgleiche, Audits, KPIs auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit) durchführen und die Integration der CMDB mit anderen Tools (Monitoring, Anfälligkeitsmanagement, Asset Management) sicherstellen.

Prozess- und Qualitätsmanagement - Standardisieren und kontinuierlich verbessern IT Service Delivery Prozesse in Übereinstimmung mit ITIL Best Practices. - Definieren, verfolgen und melden KPIs und Metriken in Bezug auf Incident, Problem, Change, Vulnerability Management, ITSM-Toolnutzung und CMDB-Qualität. - Entwickeln Sie Dashboards und regelmäßige Berichte für IT Management und Governance-Komitees, mit ITSM und zugehörigen Daten zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung. - Beitrag zur Prüfungsbereitschaft und Einhaltung von IT Service Management- und Vulnerability Management-Prozessen (interne und externe Audits).

- Förderung einer Kultur der Service-Exzellenz, des Kundeninteresses und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung im Team und in der IT. - Lead post-inident reviews (PIR) und Änderung der Bewertungen, um die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse zu ermitteln und Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen zu fördern.

Team Leadership - Führen, coachen und entwickeln Service Delivery Teammitglieder, einschließlich Performance Management und Kompetenzentwicklung. - Organisieren Sie Arbeitsbelastung, Prioritäten und On-Call / Dienst Vereinbarungen, wenn zutreffend. - Förderung der Zusammenarbeit mit anderen IT-Teams (Infrastruktur, Entwicklung, Sicherheit) und Unternehmen Stakeholder. - Sicherstellen Sie eine klare, transparente Kommunikation innerhalb des Teams und mit Management. - Entwicklung von Teamfähigkeiten in ITIL, ITSM-Tools, Kommunikation und Krisenmanagement durch Coaching, Mentoring und Trainingspläne.

- Bewältigung von großen Vorfällen und Krisensituationen durch Gewährleistung einer wirksamen Koordinierung, Priorisierung und Kommunikation. - Förderung einer kooperativen, inklusiven und rechenschaftspflichtigen Teamkultur.

Qualifikationen und Qualifikationen

Bildung - High School / Maturité / Baccalaureat oder höheres Studium in Informatik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

Technische Fähigkeiten - ITIL-Zertifizierung (oder gleichwertiges IT Service Management Framework) erforderlich. - Solide Erfahrung mit ITSM-Tools und CMDB-Konzepten, idealerweise Jira Service Management. - Gutes Verständnis der IT-Infrastruktur und Anwendungsumgebungen im Bankenkontext. - Erfahrung mit Vulnerability Management Prozessen und Tools (z.B. Schwachstellenscanner, Dashboards, Sanierungsworkflows) ist ein starker Vorteil. - Fähigkeit, ITSM und operative Dashboards (z.B. mit integrierten Reporting-Tools, BI-Tools) zu erstellen und zu interpretieren und Daten für Entscheidungen zu nutzen.

Erfahrung - 5–7 Jahre Erfahrung im IT Service Management oder einer ähnlichen Rolle (Intermediate Management Level). - Erfahrung im Finanzsektor: Pflicht. - Erfahrung im Management von Prozessen in den Bereichen Vorfälle, Problem und Veränderung und/oder Leitung eines Service Delivery Teams. - Erfahrung im Umgang mit Sicherheits- und Cyberteams zu Sicherheits- oder Risikomanagement-Themen ist ein Vorteil. - Erfahrung in der Bewältigung von Großereignissen und der Kommunikation mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern während Krisen demonstriert.

Soft Skills - Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit (mündlich und schriftlich), mit der Fähigkeit, technische Themen nicht-technischem Publikum zu erklären und unter Druck klar zu kommunizieren. - Kunden- und serviceorientierte Denkweise mit starken Priorisierungs- und Verhandlungskompetenzen. - Fähigkeit, Stress zu bewältigen und fundierte Entscheidungen in Hochdrucksituationen (z.B. Großereignissen) zu treffen. - Fähigkeit, ohne direkte hierarchische Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und starke Beziehungen zwischen IT-, Cybersecurity-, Risiko- und Business-Teams aufzubauen.

- Strukturierter, analytischer und datengetriebener Ansatz zur Problemlösung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

Sprachen - Französisch: Fluent. - Englisch: Fluent.

Arbeitsumfeld - Position in Genf, in einem internationalen Bankenumfeld. - Häufige Interaktionen mit multi-site und cross-funktionalen Teams (IT, Cybersecurity, Risk, Business Lines). - Teilnahme an Telefon-/Dienstwechseln kann je nach betrieblichem Bedarf erforderlich sein.

Sonstige - Schweizer Residenzpflicht

Kernkompetenzen - Unternehmensverträglichkeit, Werte: Widmung, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Profil d'emploi : Prestation des services de TI – Chef d'équipe

Ministère - COO – Prestation de services TI / TI

Emplacement - Genève – Sur place (non hybride)

Type d'emploi - temps plein (permanent)

Rapports au - Chef de la gestion des services informatiques

Date - 01.08.2026

Sommaire du travail - La prestation des services de TI – Chef d'équipe est responsable de la gestion quotidienne des opérations et de la gouvernance des processus de gestion des services de TI (GSTI) au sein de l'UBP, en mettant l'accent sur la gestion des incidents, des problèmes, des changements et des vulnérabilités, l'outil de gestion de l'ISCI (Gestion des services de Jira) et la gouvernance de la DGCM. - Le rôle assure une qualité de service élevée aux utilisateurs finaux et aux cadres supérieurs, garantit le strict respect des processus de gestion de l'ISCI et de la vulnérabilité et contribue à l'amélioration continue de la prestation des services de TI au sein de la Banque.

- Au-delà de la propriété des processus, le rôle contribue directement à la continuité des activités de la Banque, en réduisant l'impact des incidents informatiques sur l'entreprise et en améliorant l'expérience globale des utilisateurs. Le responsable de l'équipe agit comme une référence clé de la TI dans le domaine de la TI, dirige les processus de façon axée sur les données et collabore étroitement avec les intervenants en TI, en cybersécurité, en risque et en affaires.

Principales responsabilités

Gestion des incidents de TI - Coordonner et superviser le processus de gestion des incidents de TI de bout en bout. - Assurer la communication et la communication opportunes, claires et appropriées de l'auditoire sur les incidents de TI aux utilisateurs finaux, à la gestion de la TI et aux intervenants opérationnels. - Surveiller les tendances des incidents, cerner les problèmes récurrents et proposer des mesures correctives et préventives. - Veiller à ce que les ALS, les exigences réglementaires (y compris la DORA) et les normes internes de qualité soient respectées. - Mesurer et améliorer la satisfaction des utilisateurs (p. ex., les sondages post-incidents, le CSAT) et minimiser l'impact opérationnel et les temps d'arrêt des services essentiels.

Gestion des problèmes de TI - Coordonner et superviser les activités de gestion des problèmes de TI. - Faciliter l'analyse des causes profondes, assurer la documentation appropriée des erreurs connues et maintenir une solide base de données sur les erreurs connues. - Communiquer et faire rapport sur les problèmes de TI aux intervenants de la TI, avec un auditoire plus technique que la gestion des incidents. - Suivre les plans d'action pour prévenir la réapparition d'incidents majeurs et suivre leur efficacité au fil du temps. - Maintenir une communication étroite avec le bureau de service pour détecter les tendances et les problèmes émergents, en tirant parti des données et des tendances de la GSTI pour prioriser les problèmes à impact élevé.

Gestion du changement de TI - Diriger le processus de gestion du changement de TI : évaluation du risque, validation, présentation et suivi de tous les changements de TI dans la production. - Assurer le strict respect des processus de changement de TI pour protéger la Banque contre les changements non déclarés ou mal évalués. - Présider ou participer activement aux comités consultatifs sur le changement (CCB) et assurer la documentation et la communication des décisions appropriées. - Surveiller les ICR sur le changement (taux de réussite, taux de retour, incidents liés aux changements) et favoriser l'amélioration continue.

- Aligner le processus de gestion du changement sur les pratiques Agile/ DevOps utilisées par les équipes de développement et d'infrastructure, tout en maintenant la conformité, la stabilité et la sécurité.

Gestion de la vulnérabilité - Superviser le processus de gestion de la vulnérabilité de bout en bout en coordination avec les équipes de cybersécurité et d'infrastructure. - S'assurer que la vulnérabilité est analysée, évaluée et appliquée régulièrement en fonction des risques et des répercussions opérationnelles. - Coordonner les plans d'assainissement, suivre les progrès et les augmentations lorsque les délais ou les seuils de risque ne sont pas respectés. - S'assurer de l'alignement entre les processus de gestion de la vulnérabilité et de gestion des incidents, des problèmes et des changements (p. ex., l'assainissement par des changements standard ou d'urgence).

Propriété de l'outil de la MSI - Agir comme propriétaire de l'outil de la MSI utilisé par tous les utilisateurs de la TI pour enregistrer les incidents, les changements, les problèmes, les demandes et les ordres de travail. - Gérer le cycle de vie de la plate-forme, y compris les demandes d'évolution, les changements de configuration et les tâches opérationnelles quotidiennes. - Coordonner avec les équipes techniques les mises à niveau, les intégrations et les améliorations du rendement. - Assurer la qualité des données, la cohérence des catégories et une expérience conviviale au sein de l'outil. - Définir et développer le modèle de données de la MSI (types de billet, workflows, champs obligatoires) pour appuyer les besoins en matière de rapports, de vérification et d'amélioration continue.

- Promouvoir l'automatisation (routage, notifications, intégrations avec d'autres outils) pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Gouvernance de la DGCM - Assurer la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie de la DGCM définie par la haute direction. - Superviser la qualité, l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude des données de configuration utilisées dans les processus de gestion des incidents, des changements et des vulnérabilités. - Proposer et suivre les domaines d'amélioration de la structure, des processus et des contrôles de la DGCM. - Coordonner avec les équipes chargées de l'infrastructure et des applications afin de maintenir des relations et des dépendances précises entre les éléments de configuration.

- Mettre en place des contrôles réguliers de la qualité des données (recombinaisons, audits, ICR sur l'exhaustivité et la justesse) et assurer l'intégration de la DGCM avec d'autres outils (surveillance, gestion de la vulnérabilité, gestion des actifs).

Gestion des processus et de la qualité - Normaliser et améliorer continuellement les processus de prestation des services de TI conformément aux pratiques exemplaires de l'ITIL. - Définir, suivre et signaler les ICR et les paramètres liés aux incidents, aux problèmes, aux changements, à la gestion de la vulnérabilité, à l'utilisation des outils de la GSTI et à la qualité de la DGDGCM. - Élaborer des tableaux de bord et des rapports réguliers pour les comités de gestion et de gouvernance de la TI, en utilisant la GSTI et les données connexes pour appuyer la prise de décisions. - Contribuer à la vérification de la préparation et de la conformité des processus de gestion de la gestion des services de TI et de la vulnérabilité (vérifications internes et externes).

- Promouvoir une culture d'excellence en matière de services, de concentration sur les clients et d'amélioration continue au sein de l'équipe et dans l'ensemble des TI. - Examens des principaux incidents et examens des changements afin de cerner les leçons apprises et de mener des actions correctives et préventives.

Leadership de l'équipe - Diriger, entraîner et développer les membres de l'équipe de prestation des services, y compris la gestion du rendement et le perfectionnement des compétences. - Organiser la charge de travail, les priorités et les arrangements de garde et de service, le cas échéant. - Favoriser la collaboration avec d'autres équipes de TI (infrastructure, perfectionnement, sécurité) et les intervenants commerciaux. - Assurer une communication claire et transparente au sein de l'équipe et avec la direction. - Développer les capacités de l'équipe en matière de TIIL, d'outils de la GTI, de communication et de gestion des crises par le biais de plans de coaching, de mentorat et de formation.

- Gérer les incidents majeurs et les situations de crise en assurant une coordination efficace, la mise en œuvre et la communication des projets d'ici à l'an dernier.

Compétences et qualifications

Éducation - École secondaire / maturité / Baccalauréat ou diplôme supérieur en technologie de l'information, informatique ou un domaine connexe.

Compétences techniques - Certification ITIL (ou cadre de gestion des services informatiques équivalent) nécessaire. - Une solide expérience des outils de gestion de la vulnérabilité (par exemple, scanners de vulnérabilité, tableaux de bord, processus de restauration) est un atout important. - Capacité de construire et d'interpréter les STIM et les tableaux de bord opérationnels (par exemple, l'utilisation d'outils de déclaration intégrés, de BI) et d'utiliser les données pour diriger les décisions.

Expérience - 5-7 ans d'expérience en gestion des services de TI ou un rôle similaire (niveau de gestion intermédiaire). - Expérience dans le secteur financier : obligatoire. - Expérience prouvée en gestion des processus d'incident, de problème et de changement et/ou en direction d'une équipe de prestation de services. - Expérience de travail avec des équipes de sécurité/ cyber-sécurité sur des sujets de vulnérabilité ou de gestion des risques est un avantage. - Expérience démontrée dans la gestion des incidents majeurs et la communication avec les intervenants supérieurs en situation de crise.

Compétences en souplesse - Capacités de communication (orales et écrites) solides, capables d'expliquer des sujets techniques aux auditoires non techniques et de communiquer clairement sous pression. - Capacité de communiquer avec les clients et les services, avec des compétences solides en matière de négociation et de gestion des projets de recherche et de formation. - Capacité de gérer le stress et de prendre des décisions éclairées dans des situations de haute pression (p. ex. incidents majeurs). - Capacité d'influencer sans autorité hiérarchique directe et d'établir de solides relations entre les équipes de TI, de cybersécurité, de risque et d'affaires.

- Approche structurée, analytique et axée sur les données pour la résolution des problèmes et l'amélioration continue.

Langues - Français : Fluent. - Anglais : Fluent.

Environnement de travail - Position basée à Genève, dans un environnement bancaire international. - Les interactions Frequent avec les équipes multi-site et inter-fonctionnelles (TI, cybersécurité, risques, secteurs d'activité). - La participation aux rotations de service/à la demande peut être nécessaire en fonction des besoins opérationnels.

Autres - Résidence suisse Obligatoire

Compétences de base - Adhérence à l'entreprise, valeurs : Dedication, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Conformité aux règlements et directives internes

• Mission

• As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Troubleshoot and improve AD replication, DNS, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

• Implement and enforce security policies, including password policies, account lockout policies, and auditing.

• Integrate Active Directory with other systems, such as Office 365, Azure AD, and third-party applications.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation of routine tasks and reporting

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans for Active Directory.

• Setting up and maintaining Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities.

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in :

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• PKI and certificat management

• SCCM

• Exchange 2019

• Powershell scripting

• MS Teams

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Intune

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

•

• Others
• Swiss Residence

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Senior Wealth Planner - Zurich

titleByLocale.fr: Planificateur principal de gestion patrimoniale - Zurich

jobs.description:
You will join the Wealth Planning Team at Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) in Zurich, Switzerland.
 In this role, you will serve clients and partner with Relationship Managers to ensure that wealth planning needs are appropriately addressed.
 You will provide guidance on succession and legacy planning, tax suitability, mobility planning, and wealth structuring—based on each client’s specific circumstances—to create added value and mitigate risk, collaborating with Compliance on an on-demand basis to ensure alignment with KYC/AML requirements and internal policies.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Sie werden Mitglied im Wealth Planning Team der Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) in Zürich, Schweiz. In dieser Funktion dienen Sie Kunden und Partner mit Relationship Managern, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bedürfnisse der Vermögensplanung angemessen berücksichtigt werden. Sie werden Beratung zu Nachfolge- und Altplanung, Steuertauglichkeit, Mobilitätsplanung und Vermögensstrukturierung bieten – basierend auf jedem Kunden, spezifischen Umständen – um Mehrwert zu schaffen und Risiken zu mindern, und mit Compliance auf Abruf zusammenwirken, um die Anpassung an die Anforderungen von KYC/AML und interne Richtlinien zu gewährleisten.

Die Rolle umfasst auch die Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Präsentationen über konforme Strategien und Optionen für die Vermögensplanung, die Unterstützung der Kunden, die sich schnell verändernden, immer komplexeren Regelungen und den Schutz ihres Reichtums zu unterstützen, während sie das Einkommen nach Steuern maximieren, sowie die Vorbereitung rechtzeitiger, genauer interner Wealth Planning Alerts und Client Memorandums zu den oben beschriebenen Themen.

Verantwortungen - Proaktive Zusammenarbeit mit Bankern, um Kunden, Bedürfnisse zu erkennen und zu antizipieren, Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und zu erfassen. - Private Banker mit aktuellen, relevanten technischen Informationen zu schulen, um die Auswirkungen der Steuer- und Rechtsentwicklungen zu verstehen und entsprechende Maßnahmen zu ergreifen. - Identifizieren, präsentieren und diskutieren Sie geeignete und konforme Lösungen und Strategien zur Vermögensplanung, um Kunden, Bedürfnissen zu entsprechen: bieten maßgeschneiderte Service und maßgeschneiderte Strategien.

- Treffen Sie Kunden und Interessenten (einschließlich Geschäftsreisen mit Bankern) - Aktiv fördern Wealth Planning Dienstleistungen in der gesamten Bank durch Ad-hoc-Präsentationen und Publikationen zu ausgewählten, hochwirksamen Themen; aktiv unterstützen Steuer-und rechtliche Vermögen-Erhaltung Ziele. - Aufrechterhaltung eines hohen technischen Know-how auf dedizierten Märkten und nehmen einen effektiven, risikobasierten und ergebnisorientierten Ansatz zur Risikominderung. - Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Vermittlern wie Vertrauen und Corporate Service Provider, Steuern und Anwaltskanzleien.

- Erfüllen Sie die externen und internen Compliance- und regulatorischen Anforderungen, einschließlich der Bank, die Richtlinien, Betriebsabläufe und Kontrollen, um die Bank, die regulatorischen Anforderungen und schützen das Geschäft vor rechtlichen, finanziellen und Reputationsrisiken. - Integrieren Sie mit dem lokalen Team von Wealth Planners mit Sitz in Zürich; Zusammenarbeit in der UBP-Gruppe; Bericht an Head of Wealth Planning – Schweiz, mit Sitz in Genf.

- Partner mit der Compliance-Abteilung, um komplexe bestehende Fälle und Treuhand-/Eigentumsstrukturen (Trusts, Foundations, SPVs) streng auf Compliance-initiierter Basis zu überprüfen; Überprüfung von wirtschaftlichen Eigentümer- und Dokumentenstrukturierungs-Richtungen gemäß KYC/AML-Richtlinien und grenzübergreifenden Regeln. - Unterstützung von strukturlastigen Kunden nur auf Compliance-Anforderung: UBO-Identifikation, Begründung, erforderliche Entitätsdokumentation, Eigentümerdiagramme und Begründungs-Memorandume, um die Compliance-Zulassung zu erleichtern.

- Führen Sie periodische und ereignisgesteuerte Bewertungen (z.B. KYC refresh, trigger events) ausschließlich durch Compliance-Anregung durch.

Voraussetzungen - 12+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Vermögensplanung - Tiefe Expertise in Großbritannien und angelsächsischen Vermögensstrukturierung, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz in diesen Ländern. - Breites, fortgeschrittenes Wissen über Kern-Wohlstandsplanungsdisziplinen (Steuer, Rechts-, Nachfolge-, Governance), die durch komplexe Fallausführung und Kundenwirkung belegt sind.

- Die für diese Rolle erforderliche Rechtsgrundlage/die für diese Rolle erforderliche Sprachkompetenz in Englisch; Deutsch und weitere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil - Vertraulicher, überzeugender Kommunikator mit hervorragenden Präsentationskompetenzen - Herausragende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen für vielfältige Zielgruppen zu vereinfachen - Resilient und anpassungsfähig: unter Druck zu treten, effektiv zu priorisieren und hohe Standards zu halten - Selbst-Visitiert, Service getrieben und unerbittlich auf Kundenergebnisse konzentriert - Starker Teamplayer, hoch organisiert mit außergewöhnlicher Liebe zum Detail

Was wir anbieten Das ist eine 100%ige Rolle in Zürich.

Description Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de planification de patrimoine de l'Union bancaire privée (UBP) à Zurich, en Suisse. Vous servirez des clients et vous associerez avec les responsables de la planification de patrimoine pour s'assurer que les besoins en planification de patrimoine sont bien pris en compte. Vous fournirez des conseils sur la planification de succession et de patrimoine, la pertinence fiscale, la planification de la mobilité et la structuration de patrimoine – en fonction des circonstances particulières de chaque client – afin de créer de la valeur ajoutée et d'atténuer les risques, en collaborant avec la conformité à la demande afin d'assurer l'alignement avec les exigences de KYC/AML et les politiques internes.

Le rôle consiste également à offrir une formation et des présentations sur les stratégies et les options de planification du patrimoine conformes, à aider les clients à rester en avance sur des règlements qui changent rapidement et qui deviennent de plus en plus complexes et à protéger leur patrimoine tout en maximisant les revenus après impôt et en préparant des alertes internes et des notes de service sur les sujets susmentionnés.

Responsabilités - Engagement proactif auprès des banquiers pour reconnaître et anticiper les clients, les besoins et pour identifier et saisir les occasions d'affaires. - Fournir et former des banquiers privés avec des renseignements techniques à jour et pertinents pour comprendre les évolutions fiscales et juridiques et prendre les mesures appropriées. - Identifier, présenter et discuter des solutions et stratégies de planification du patrimoine appropriées et conformes pour répondre aux besoins des clients : fournir un service personnalisé et des stratégies sur mesure.

- Mettre en place et maintenir un réseau d'intermédiaires tels que les prestataires de services de confiance et de services aux sociétés, les cabinets d'avocats et les cabinets d'avocats.

- Se conformer aux exigences de conformité et de réglementation externes et internes, y compris la Banque, aux politiques, procédures opérationnelles et contrôles pour satisfaire à la Banque, aux exigences réglementaires et protéger l'entreprise contre les risques juridiques, financiers et de réputation. - Se joindre à l'équipe locale de planificateurs de patrimoine basée à Zurich; collaborer à travers le groupe UBP; faire rapport au responsable de la planification de patrimoine – Suisse, basée à Genève.

- Établir un partenariat avec le Département de la conformité pour examiner les cas complexes et les structures fiduciaires/propriété (fiducies, fondations, SPV) sur demande et sur demande; vérifier les justifications de la propriété effective et de la structure des documents conformément aux politiques et aux règles transfrontalières de KYC/AML. - Soutien à l'embarquement des clients ayant une structure ou une hache uniquement sur demande de conformité : identification UBO, justification, documentation requise de l'entité, diagrammes de propriété et notes de justification pour faciliter l'approbation de la conformité.

- Effectuer des examens périodiques et des examens axés sur des événements (p. ex., rafraîchissement du CJK, événements déclencheurs) exclusivement lorsque la conformité a été amorcée.

Exigences - 12 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente dans les services de planification de patrimoine - Une expertise approfondie au Royaume-Uni et en Anglo-Saxon, avec un succès prouvé dans ces juridictions. - Connaissances étendues et avancées dans les disciplines de base de planification de patrimoine (fiscalité, juridique, succession, gouvernance), mis en évidence par l'exécution de cas complexes et l'impact client.

- Fond de droit/diplôme requis pour ce rôle - Fluence en anglais; l'allemand et les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage - Confident, persuasif communicateur avec d'excellentes compétences de présentation - Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de simplifier des sujets complexes pour des publics variés - Résilient et adaptable : capable de fonctionner sous pression, de prioriser efficacement et de maintenir des normes élevées - Automotivé, motivé par le service et constamment axé sur les résultats des clients - Fort joueur d'équipe, hautement organisé avec une attention exceptionnelle aux détails

Ce que nous offrons C'est un rôle 100% situé à Zurich.

jobs.title: Head of Cyber Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Mission
Lead the Bank’s Cyber Engineering function to design, build, and operate secure-by-design platforms and controls that proactively prevent, detect, and respond to cyber threats. Own the end-to-end engineering roadmap for cyber capabilities, ensuring resilience, reliability, and compliance across hybrid on prem and cloud environments.
 Main responsibilities
• Define and execute the cyber engineering roadmap aligned to the Bank’s risk appetite and business goals.
• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team across security engineering, DevSecOps, and cyber platform operations.
• Own budget, vendor strategy, and capacity planning for cyber tooling and platforms.
• Establish and enforce security-by-design and security-by-default patterns across infrastructure, applications, and data.
• Industrialize security controls via automation, IaC, and CI/CD integration; shift-left security in development lifecycle.
• Own the roadmap, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise-class security platforms (e.g., EDR/XDR, PAM, CSPM, DLP, HSM, etc.).
• Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of cyber platforms with robust SLAs and KPIs.

Your Profile
• Visionary cyber engineering leader with deep hands-on and the ability to translate complex security requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
• Proven experience building and running security platforms in complex, regulated financial environments.

Education
• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.
Experience Technical skills
• Senior: 7-10 years of experience.
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security area related to one or more of the following domains: security architecture, security engineering and integration or secure application development.

Languages
• French : fluent
• English : Strong advantage
 Personal skills
• Self-motivated leader with ownership mindset; able to operate strategically while remaining hands-on when needed.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate technical risk into business impact.
• Strong critical thinking, analytical problem-solving, and decision-making under pressure.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex, multi-department initiatives.
• High integrity, resilience, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Others
• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Head of Securities Transfer
jobs.description:
• Mission

• Support and be able to treat all processing covering the management of activities relating to Securities Transfer changes which will affect all kind of assets (including alternative assets such as mutual funds, Private Equities and Hedge Funds).

• Manage and oversee a team processing in light of the funds activities including private equities.

• Be able to work closely with our key players to meet our customers' expectations.

• Be responsible to lead, mentor staff and provide oversight to ensure events are processed timely and accurately. Be able to work closely with our key players to meet our customers' expectations.

Management responsibilities:

• Present strategic opportunities to mitigate risk.

• Maintain our KPI/KRI indices internal to our business with a view to mitigating the risk associated with the securities transfer activities.

• Be responsible for its activity by working closely with the various divisions of the bank in order to be up to date with the various regulations impacting our securities transfer activity.

• Ensure department procedures are adhered to, review and maintain client task list and related SLA's.

• Communicate effectively and efficiently across departments, with staff, with senior management.

• Lead staff meetings, participate on project management and industry events.

• Ensure daily follow up in respect of pending issues and take appropriate measures for resolution.

Daily business responsibilities:

• Crossed analysis of the received information: custodian’s swifts, agent prospectus, contract notes and financial providers such as: Bloomberg, Telekurs.

• Perform control of reconciliation of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions management.

• Be able to manage and control securities transfer instructions received from Wealth Management and external parties (transfer IN/OUT/Internal and funds registration process).

• Control transmission of the deposits to our correspondents/Transfer Agents/Administrators and control of their safe delivery and acceptance.

• Follow-up of the topics and issues over the lifecycle of the securities transfer activities.

• Your Profile

• Education : Bachelor’s degree

• Languages : French and English: fluent

• Personal skills:
• Think in "Problem-Action-Results" terms.

• Be proactive and driven.

• Show strong client service ethic.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

• Highly organized, manage tight deadlines within a high risk environment, ability to work under pressure.

• Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions.

• Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way.

• Be a continuous learner.

• Adaptability, self-motivation and team work.

• Build lasting client relationships.

• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations.

• Strong analytical skills and organized.

• Attention to detail and accuracy.

• Others
• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Mission
• Unterstützen und in der Lage sein, alle Verarbeitungen zu behandeln, die die Verwaltung von Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Änderungen der Wertpapierübertragung betreffen, die alle Arten von Vermögenswerten betreffen (einschließlich alternativer Vermögenswerte wie Investmentfonds, Private Equities und Hedgefonds).
• Verwalten und beaufsichtigen Sie eine Teambearbeitung im Lichte der Fondsaktivitäten, einschließlich Private Equity.
• Wir können eng mit unseren Key Playern zusammenarbeiten, um die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu erfüllen.
• Seien Sie dafür verantwortlich, das Personal zu leiten, zu betreuen und die Aufsicht zu übernehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass Ereignisse rechtzeitig und genau verarbeitet werden. Wir können eng mit unseren Key Playern zusammenarbeiten, um die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu erfüllen. Verwaltungszuständigkeiten:
• Präsentieren Sie strategische Chancen zur Risikominderung.
• Pflegen Sie unsere internen KPI / KRI-Indizes, um das mit den Wertpapiertransferaktivitäten verbundene Risiko zu mindern.
• Seien Sie für seine Tätigkeit verantwortlich, indem Sie eng mit den verschiedenen Abteilungen der Bank zusammenarbeiten, um mit den verschiedenen Vorschriften, die sich auf unsere Wertpapiertransferaktivitäten auswirken, auf dem Laufenden zu sein.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Verfahren der Abteilung eingehalten werden, überprüfen und pflegen Sie die Aufgabenliste der Kunden und die damit verbundenen SLAs.
• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv und effizient über Abteilungen hinweg, mit Mitarbeitern und mit der Geschäftsleitung.
• Leiten Sie Mitarbeiterbesprechungen, nehmen Sie an Projektmanagement- und Branchenveranstaltungen teil.
• Gewährleistung der täglichen Nachverfolgung von anhängigen Problemen und Ergreifung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Lösung. Tägliche Geschäftsverantwortung:
• Kreuzanalyse der erhaltenen Informationen: Treuhänder, Agentenprospekt, Vertragsanweisungen und Finanzdienstleister wie: Bloomberg, Telekurs.
• Kontrolle der Überleitung von Beteiligungen, der Bestimmung von Anspruchen und der Verwaltung von ausstehenden Positionen.
• In der Lage sein, die von Wealth Management und externen Parteien erhaltenen Wertpapiertransferanweisungen zu verwalten und zu kontrollieren (Transfer IN / Out / Intern und Fondsregistrierungsprozess).
• Kontrolle der Übertragung der Einzahlungen an unsere Korrespondenten/Transferagenten/Administratoren und Kontrolle ihrer sicheren Lieferung und Annahme.
• Follow-up der Themen und Themen über den Lebenszyklus der Wertpapiertransferaktivitäten.

• Halten Sie Qualitätsstandards trotz Zeitplan Druck.
• Hoch organisiert, verwalten enge Fristen in einem Umfeld mit hohem Risiko, Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten.

jobs.title: Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Job description
 Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician

NAME:

CORPORATE JOB TITLE:
 Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician

POSITION:
 Associate

REPORTS TO:
 Facilities Manager

SIGNIFICANT MANAGEMENT FUNCTION (YES/NO):
 No

PRESCRIBED RESPONSBILITY:
 N/A

MATERIAL RISK TAKER (YES/NO):
 No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
 No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
 N/A

LAST UPDATED:
 June 2026

Main Responsibilities
 The Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician role is a key member of the Facilities team whose primary role is to assist the Facilities Manager in the day-to-day building and facilities operations, including carrying out general maintenance, portering, spatial arrangement, furniture (chairs, desks, lockers, pedestal & key) management within the office building, monitoring compliance, liaison with the Physical Security on Access Passes and overseeing deliveries when required, and maintaining safe-keeping of the doors’ keys to allow access for maintenance and repairs on a day-to-day basis.

Role Duties
 General Security BAU

• Under the supervision of the Facilities Manager, the duty holder will be responsible for minor reactive maintenance, PPMs, furniture rearrangement, equipment ad-hoc repairs, and general upkeep of the building fabric.

• To assist with any reactive or planned preventative maintenance which may include plumbing tasks required throughout the office - i.e., Changing taps, unblocked toilet, mending leaks, and replacing toilets seats, etc.

• To carry out minor planned and unplanned general maintenance duties related to the building infrastructures, mechanical plants and equipment systems and to complete relevant paperwork in connection with the above works.

• Experience in multi skilled trades and general handyperson duties (e.g. carpentry, tilling, changing locks, etc).

• To respond to any facilities maintenance requests made by staff timely, efficiently and to a high standard.

• To work co-operatively with other departments especially the Communications Teams, Catering and IT as well as external stakeholders on facilities issues, and provide support where required.

• To be available for occasional emergency call outs outside normal business hours to respond to maintenance emergencies evenings or weekends as may requested by the Facilities Manager.

• To act in the role of Fire Marshal and be part of the Fire Safety Team during fire emergency evacuation.

• Provide necessary support during fire evacuation, 6-monthly fire drill and weekly fire alarm testing.

• To complete periodic checks of the building infrastructural assets and report back to the Facilities Manager.

• Monitor access, and respond to security or safety alerts and incidents.

• Overseeing deliveries and signing for packages when required.

• Keeping fire evacuation exit doors cleared of obstructions.

• Internal spaces arrangement for meetings and events as required by the organisers or Facilities Manager.

• Contributing to the maintenance of the building by reporting faults or damage to fittings and fixtures , and coordinate with outsourced maintenance teams for repairs.

• Proficiency with computer systems for record-keeping, CCTV monitoring, and other administrative tasks.

• Monitoring daily, weekly or monthly waste collections, including general, food, mixed recycling, WEEE, sanitary and confidential wastes.

• Monthly utilities meters readings – i.e., Water and Electricity.

• To undertake any other duties within the competence of the post holder, as may be required from time to time.

•
 The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management .

Number of Post & Working Hours

• This is a single position and the duty holder will work as Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician.

• The working hours is: 0800 – 1700 Monday to Friday and as may be required by the business.

•
 Business Continuity

• Remote Working – N/A.

Committee Membership

• None

Conduct Rules
 This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;

• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and

• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
 Knowledge, Skills & Experience

• Able to move furniture items of over 20kg.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to maintain positive attitude and professional tone all time.

• Candidates who have worked as a Facilities Assistant, Building Technician, Estates Coordinator or General Multi-skilled Technician/Handyperson.

• Able to respond appropriately with quick thinking and decision making even when they are put on the spot.

• Overseeing the safe keeping of the building’s keys to allow access for maintenance and repairs when necessary.

• Candidates that have worked in financial institutions, hospitality or similar environment and have experience of multitasking, maintaining a professional attitude and delivering excellent customer service.

• Persons specified must possess general building and facilities training gaining through formal education or hands-on, and should have minimum of GCSE passes or equivalent, particularly in English and Math.

• Candidates that speak more than one language have an advantage, as do those who have completed training in facilities management, moving and handling, health and safety or customer service.

• Competent with tools to assist with basic premises issues.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, to deal with staff of all levels.

•
 Competencies and Values Required Level

Facilities and customer focus 4
 Shows the drive to perform and be successful 4
 Persistent in following up and through on issues 3
 Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 2
 Good product knowledge 1
 Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 1
 Business Development 1
 Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 3
 Influencing 1
 Knowledge of Products and Services 1
 Relationship Building - internal and external 3
 Strategic & commercial awareness 1
 Planning & organising 2
 Ethics and values 4

Job description
Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician

NAME:

CORPORATE JOB TITLE:
Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician

POSITION:
Associate

REPORTS TO:
Facilities Manager

SIGNIFICANT MANAGEMENT FUNCTION (YES/NO):
No

PRESCRIBED RESPONSBILITY:
N/A

MATERIAL RISK TAKER (YES/NO):
No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
N/A

LAST UPDATED:
June 2026

Main Responsibilities
The Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician role is a key member of the Facilities team whose primary role is to assist the Facilities Manager in the day-to-day building and facilities operations, including carrying out general maintenance, portering, spatial arrangement, furniture (chairs, desks, lockers, pedestal & key) management within the office building, monitoring compliance, liaison with the Physical Security on Access Passes and overseeing deliveries when required, and maintaining safe-keeping of the doors’ keys to allow access for maintenance and repairs on a day-to-day basis.

Role Duties
General Security BAU

• Under the supervision of the Facilities Manager, the duty holder will be responsible for minor reactive maintenance, PPMs, furniture rearrangement, equipment ad-hoc repairs, and general upkeep of the building fabric.

• To assist with any reactive or planned preventative maintenance which may include plumbing tasks required throughout the office - i.e., Changing taps, unblocked toilet, mending leaks, and replacing toilets seats, etc.

• To carry out minor planned and unplanned general maintenance duties related to the building infrastructures, mechanical plants and equipment systems and to complete relevant paperwork in connection with the above works.

• Experience in multi skilled trades and general handyperson duties (e.g. carpentry, tilling, changing locks, etc).

• To respond to any facilities maintenance requests made by staff timely, efficiently and to a high standard.

• To work co-operatively with other departments especially the Communications Teams, Catering and IT as well as external stakeholders on facilities issues, and provide support where required.

• To be available for occasional emergency call outs outside normal business hours to respond to maintenance emergencies evenings or weekends as may requested by the Facilities Manager.

• To act in the role of Fire Marshal and be part of the Fire Safety Team during fire emergency evacuation.

• Provide necessary support during fire evacuation, 6-monthly fire drill and weekly fire alarm testing.

• To complete periodic checks of the building infrastructural assets and report back to the Facilities Manager.

• Monitor access, and respond to security or safety alerts and incidents.

• Overseeing deliveries and signing for packages when required.

• Keeping fire evacuation exit doors cleared of obstructions.

• Internal spaces arrangement for meetings and events as required by the organisers or Facilities Manager.

• Contributing to the maintenance of the building by reporting faults or damage to fittings and fixtures , and coordinate with outsourced maintenance teams for repairs.

• Proficiency with computer systems for record-keeping, CCTV monitoring, and other administrative tasks.

• Monitoring daily, weekly or monthly waste collections, including general, food, mixed recycling, WEEE, sanitary and confidential wastes.

• Monthly utilities meters readings – i.e., Water and Electricity.

• To undertake any other duties within the competence of the post holder, as may be required from time to time.

•
The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management .

Number of Post & Working Hours

• This is a single position and the duty holder will work as Multi-skilled Maintenance Technician.

• The working hours is: 0800 – 1700 Monday to Friday and as may be required by the business.

•
Business Continuity

• Remote Working – N/A.

Committee Membership

• None

Conduct Rules
This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;

• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and

• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
Knowledge, Skills & Experience

• Able to move furniture items of over 20kg.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to maintain positive attitude and professional tone all time.

• Candidates who have worked as a Facilities Assistant, Building Technician, Estates Coordinator or General Multi-skilled Technician/Handyperson.

• Able to respond appropriately with quick thinking and decision making even when they are put on the spot.

• Overseeing the safe keeping of the building’s keys to allow access for maintenance and repairs when necessary.

• Candidates that have worked in financial institutions, hospitality or similar environment and have experience of multitasking, maintaining a professional attitude and delivering excellent customer service.

• Persons specified must possess general building and facilities training gaining through formal education or hands-on, and should have minimum of GCSE passes or equivalent, particularly in English and Math.

• Candidates that speak more than one language have an advantage, as do those who have completed training in facilities management, moving and handling, health and safety or customer service.

• Competent with tools to assist with basic premises issues.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, to deal with staff of all levels.

•
Competencies and Values Required Level

Facilities and customer focus 4
Shows the drive to perform and be successful 4
Persistent in following up and through on issues 3
Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 2
Good product knowledge 1
Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 1
Business Development 1
Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 3
Influencing 1
Knowledge of Products and Services 1
Relationship Building - internal and external 3
Strategic & commercial awareness 1
Planning & organising 2
Ethics and values 4

Explanation: 1: low level of competence / skill required, 2-3: average level of competence / skill required, 4-5: high level of competence skill required

• Überwachung der täglichen, wöchentlichen oder monatlichen Abfallsammlungen, einschließlich allgemeiner Abfälle, Lebensmittel, gemischtes Recycling, Elektro- und Elektronik-Altgeräte, Sanitär- und vertraulicher Abfälle.

jobs.title: System Engineer - Active Directory Specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission:

• As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities:

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Troubleshoot and improve AD replication, DNS, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

• Implement and enforce security policies, including password policies, account lockout policies, and auditing.

• Integrate Active Directory with other systems, such as Office 365, Azure AD, and third-party applications.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation of routine tasks and reporting

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans for Active Directory.

• Setting up and maintaining Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities.

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in:

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• PKI and certificat management

• SCCM

• Exchange 2019

• Powershell scripting

• MS Teams

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

• Intune

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Junior Institutional Sales Iberia/Latam (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
About UBP Asset Management
 UBP Asset Management is an international investment manager with expertise across traditional and alternative asset classes. The Iberia & LATAM team develops long-term relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers and family offices throughout the region.

Joining UBP offers the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial and international environment while building a long-term career in asset management distribution.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Junior Sales professional to join the Iberia & LATAM Distribution team in Madrid.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional (3–8 years of experience) who is passionate about financial markets and asset management and wants to develop a career in institutional and wholesale sales.

The successful candidate will support the sales team in developing relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers, distributors and family offices across Iberia and Latin America. The role offers significant exposure to client interactions, investment products, and international collaboration within UBP's Asset Management business.
 Key Responsibilities
 Business Development & Sales Support
 • Support the sales team in developing and maintaining relationships with institutional clients, private banks, wealth managers, family offices and other distribution partners across Iberia and LATAM.
 • Assist in identifying new business opportunities and contribute to client acquisition initiatives.
 • Prepare client presentations, marketing materials, meeting agendas and follow-up documentation.
 • Coordinate client meetings, roadshows and industry events.
 • Maintain CRM records and sales pipelines, ensuring accurate reporting of client activity.
 • Support responses to RFIs, RFPs and due diligence questionnaires.

Client Relationship Management
 • Build strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
 • Deliver a high standard of client service.
 • Work closely with Investment Specialists, Product Specialists, Marketing, Operations and Client Services.
 • Participate in client meetings alongside senior sales colleagues and progressively take ownership of selected relationships.

Market Intelligence
 • Monitor market trends, competitor activity and industry developments.
 • Assist in identifying sales opportunities and new market segments.
 • Contribute ideas to improve sales initiatives and client engagement.
 Experience & Requirements
 Essential Experience
 • 3–8 years of experience in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management or Financial Services.
 • Previous experience in sales support, business development, client relationship management or distribution is preferred.
 • Strong interest in investment markets and asset management.
 • Good understanding of investment products including mutual funds, fixed income, equities and multi-asset solutions.
 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 • Strong analytical, organisational and Microsoft Office skills.

Education
 • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related discipline.
 • CFA or CAIA progress is an advantage.

Languages
 • Fluent Spanish and professional English.
 • Portuguese is a strong advantage.
 Personal Attributes
 • Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in business development.
 • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
 • Self-motivated and proactive.
 • Strong team player.
 • Curious about financial markets.
 • Professional presence and high ethical standards.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su UBP Asset Management UBP Asset Management è un manager di investimento internazionale con competenze nelle classi di asset tradizionali e alternative. Il team Iberia & LATAM sviluppa relazioni a lungo termine con investitori istituzionali, banche private, gestori patrimoniali e uffici familiari in tutta la regione. Unire UBP offre l'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente imprenditoriale e internazionale, mentre la costruzione di una carriera a lungo termine nella distribuzione di asset management. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista di vendite Junior motivato e ambizioso per aderire al team Iberia & LATAM Distribution di Madrid. Questa è un'ottima opportunità per un professionista di prima assistenza (3-8 anni di esperienza) che è appassionato di mercati finanziari e asset management e vuole sviluppare una carriera nelle vendite istituzionali e all'ingrosso. Il candidato di successo sosterrà il team di vendita nello sviluppo di relazioni con investitori istituzionali, banche private, gestori di ricchezza, distributori e uffici di famiglia in Iberia e America Latina. Il ruolo offre un'esposizione significativa alle interazioni dei clienti, ai prodotti di investimento e alla collaborazione internazionale nell'ambito dell'attività di gestione patrimoniale di UBP. Principali responsabilità Sviluppo aziendale e assistenza commerciale
• Sostenere il team di vendita nello sviluppo e nel mantenimento delle relazioni con clienti istituzionali, banche private, gestori patrimoniali, uffici familiari e altri partner di distribuzione in Iberia e LATAM.
• Assistere nell'individuazione di nuove opportunità di business e contribuire a iniziative di acquisizione clienti.
• Preparare presentazioni dei clienti, materiali di marketing, agenda delle riunioni e documentazione di follow-up.
• Coordinate riunioni dei clienti, roadshow e eventi del settore.
• Mantenere i record CRM e le pipeline di vendita, assicurando la segnalazione accurata dell'attività del cliente.
• Risposte di supporto a RFI, RFP e questionari di due diligence. Gestione delle relazioni con i clienti
• Costruire relazioni forti con i clienti esistenti e potenziali.
• Fornire un alto standard di servizio client.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con specialisti di investimento, specialisti del prodotto, marketing, operazioni e servizi client.
• Partecipare alle riunioni dei clienti insieme ai colleghi di vendita senior e progressivamente prendere possesso di relazioni selezionate. Intelligenza del mercato
• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, l'attività dei concorrenti e gli sviluppi del settore.
• Assistere nell'individuazione delle opportunità di vendita e dei nuovi segmenti di mercato.
• Contribuisci idee per migliorare le iniziative di vendita e il coinvolgimento dei clienti. Esperienza e requisiti Esperienza essenziale
• 3-8 anni di esperienza in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management o Financial Services.
• L'esperienza precedente nel supporto vendite, lo sviluppo aziendale, la gestione del rapporto cliente o la distribuzione è preferita.
• Forte interesse nei mercati degli investimenti e nella gestione degli asset.
• Buona comprensione dei prodotti di investimento, compresi i fondi comuni, il reddito fisso, le azioni e le soluzioni multi-asset.
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.
• Forte capacità analitiche, organizzative e Microsoft Office. Istruzione
• Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Economia, Business Administration o disciplina relativa.
• Il progresso CFA o CAIA è un vantaggio. Lingue
• Spagnolo fluido e inglese professionale.
• Il portoghese è un forte vantaggio. Attributi personali
• Mindset commerciale con un autentico interesse per lo sviluppo aziendale.
• L'atteggiamento positivo e la volontà di imparare.
• Automotivata e proattiva.
• Forte giocatore di squadra.
• Curioso sui mercati finanziari.
• Presenza professionale e elevati standard etici.
