descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos de UBP Asset Management UBP Asset Management est un gestionnaire d'investissement international ayant une expertise dans les classes d'actifs traditionnelles et alternatives. L'équipe d'Iberia & LATAM développe des relations à long terme avec des investisseurs institutionnels, des banques privées, des gestionnaires de patrimoine et des bureaux familiaux dans toute la région. L'adhésion à l'UBP offre la possibilité de travailler dans un environnement entrepreneurial et international tout en construisant une carrière à long terme dans la distribution de la gestion d'actifs. À propos du rôle Nous recherchons un professionnel des ventes juniors motivé et ambitieux pour rejoindre l'équipe de distribution Iberia & LATAM à Madrid. C'est une excellente occasion pour un professionnel en début de carrière (3-8 ans d'expérience) passionné par les marchés financiers et la gestion d'actifs et qui souhaite développer une carrière dans les ventes institutionnelles et de gros. Le candidat retenu aidera l'équipe de vente à développer des relations avec des investisseurs institutionnels, des banques privées, des gestionnaires de patrimoine, des distributeurs et des bureaux familiaux à travers Iberia et en Amérique latine. Ce rôle offre une exposition importante aux interactions avec les clients, aux produits d'investissement et à la collaboration internationale au sein des activités de gestion d'actifs de l'UBP. jobs.title: Microsoft Cloud Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description:
Function purpose

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace solutions, with a strong background in leading or supporting on-premises to cloud transformations. In this role, you will drive the migration, implementation, and optimization of cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless adoption of M365 and modern workplace technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize our IT infrastructure, enhance productivity, and improve security.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Transformation and Migration

• Lead or contribute to on-premises to cloud migration projects, including email, collaboration tools, identity management, and endpoint management.

• Plan, execute, and validate migrations from on-premises Exchange, SharePoint, and Active Directory to Microsoft 365 and Azure AD.

• Assess and mitigate risks during migration, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

M365 Administration and Optimization

• Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Power Platform and others SaaS services.

• Configure and manage Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), including identity and access management (IAM), conditional access policies, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).

• Automate workflows and processes using PowerShell, Power Automate.

Modern Workplace Solutions

• Deploy and manage modern workplace solutions, including Windows 10/11, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Endpoint Manager and Workspace One.

• Implement and support internal and external collaboration tools like Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online.

• Ensure compliance with security and governance policies for endpoints and cloud services with Purview, Intune.

Security and Compliance

• Monitor and enforce security best practices for M365 and cloud environments.

• Conduct regular audits and implement security controls to protect data and user identities.

• Collaborate with the security team to mitigate risks and respond to incidents.

User Support and Training

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for M365 and modern workplace issues.

• Develop and deliver training programs to promote user adoption and best practices.

• Create documentation for processes, configurations, and user guides.

Collaboration and Innovation

• Work with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improving productivity and collaboration.

• Evaluate and recommend new M365 features and third-party integrations.

• Stay updated on industry trends and actor’s roadmap for cloud and workplace technologies.

Qualifications and Skills

• 3+ years of experience in administering and supporting Microsoft 365 and modern workplace technologies.

• Proven experience in leading or contributing to on-premises to cloud migration projects (e.g., Exchange to Exchange Online, SharePoint on-prem to SharePoint Online, AD to Azure AD, on-prem to on cloud configuration management with Intune).

• Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Power automate.

• Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation and administration.

• Familiarity with Windows 10/11 deployment, management, and security.

• Understanding of security best practices (CIS Framework) and identity protection, data governance and compliance (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001).

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Microsoft certifications

• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Purview, and Sentinel.

• Knowledge of hybrid cloud environments (Azure, on-premises AD, and M365 integration).

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Funzione Siamo alla ricerca di un Cloud Engineer specializzato in soluzioni Microsoft 365 e Modern Workplace, con un forte background nel leader o nel supporto alle trasformazioni cloud. In questo ruolo, guiderai la migrazione, l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione di soluzioni basate sul cloud, garantendo l'adozione senza soluzione di continuità di M365 e moderne tecnologie di lavoro. Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per modernizzare la nostra infrastruttura IT, migliorare la produttività e migliorare la sicurezza. Principali responsabilità Trasformazione e migrazione del cloud
• Condurre o contribuire a on-premises a progetti di migrazione cloud, tra cui e-mail, strumenti di collaborazione, gestione dell'identità e gestione endpoint.
• Pianificare, eseguire e convalidare le migrazioni da Exchange on-premises, SharePoint e Active Directory a Microsoft 365 e Azure AD.
• Valutare e mitigare i rischi durante la migrazione, assicurando una minima interruzione delle operazioni aziendali. M365 Amministrazione e Ottimizzazione
• Amministra e ottimizza i servizi Microsoft 365, tra cui Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams e Power Platform e altri servizi SaaS.
• Configurare e gestire Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), inclusa la gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso (IAM), le politiche di accesso condizionale e l'autenticazione multi-fattore (MFA).
• Automatizzare flussi di lavoro e processi utilizzando PowerShell, Power Automate. Soluzioni di lavoro moderne
• Distribuire e gestire soluzioni di lavoro moderne, tra cui Windows 10/11, Intune, Autopilota, Microsoft Endpoint Manager e Workspace One.
• Implementare e supportare strumenti di collaborazione interni ed esterni come Microsoft Teams e SharePoint Online.
• Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche di sicurezza e governance per endpoint e servizi cloud con Purview, Intune. Sicurezza e conformità
• Monitorare e applicare le migliori pratiche di sicurezza per gli ambienti M365 e cloud.
• Condurre controlli regolari e implementare controlli di sicurezza per proteggere i dati e le identità degli utenti.
• Collabora con il team di sicurezza per mitigare i rischi e rispondere agli incidenti. Supporto utente e formazione
• Fornire supporto tecnico e risoluzione dei problemi per M365 e problemi di lavoro moderni.
• Sviluppare e fornire programmi di formazione per promuovere l'adozione degli utenti e le migliori pratiche.
• Crea documentazione per processi, configurazioni e guide utente. Collaborazione e innovazione
• Lavorare con gli stakeholder per identificare le opportunità per migliorare la produttività e la collaborazione.
• Valuta e consiglia nuove funzionalità M365 e integrazioni di terze parti.
• Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze del settore e sulla roadmap dell’attore per le tecnologie cloud e sul posto di lavoro. Qualifiche e competenze
• 3+ anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione e nel supporto di Microsoft 365 e moderne tecnologie di lavoro.
• Provata esperienza nel portare o contribuire a on-premises a progetti di migrazione cloud (ad esempio, Exchange to Exchange Online, SharePoint on-prem to SharePoint Online, AD to Azure AD, on-prem to on-prem on-prem on-prem to su cloud di configurazione management con Intune).
• Forte conoscenza di Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams e Power automatizzare.
• Esperienza con lo scripting PowerShell per l'automazione e l'amministrazione.
• Familiarità con Windows 10/11 distribuzione, gestione e sicurezza.
• Comprensione delle best practice di sicurezza (CIS Framework) e protezione dell'identità, governance dei dati e conformità (ad esempio, GDPR, ISO 27001).
• Eccellente capacità di problem solving, comunicazione e collaborazione. Preferito
• Certificazioni Microsoft
• Esperienza con Microsoft Defender per Office 365, Purview e Sentinel.
• Conoscenza degli ambienti cloud ibridi (Azure, on-premises AD e integrazione M365). Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la transformation des opérations

jobs.description:
• Mission
 We are seeking an experienced and highly autonomous professional to join the Operations team. The role consists in reviewing, optimizing and transforming operational processes across the department.
 This position requires a strong Operational background, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to drive efficiency initiatives.
 The role requires close collaboration with Operations teams, management, IT and other stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, streamline workflows and support strategic transformation projects.

• Main responsibilities
• Conduct comprehensive reviews of existing operational processes and workflows across the department

• Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather requirements and understand operational challenges

• Identify and prioritize AI/automation use cases in Operations to reduce inefficiencies, bottlenecks, operational risk

• Design and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, service quality and operational control

• Partner with Data/IT to translate business problems into AI solutions, define data requirements, and ensure model governance and traceability.

• Coordinate AI delivery lifecycle: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training/validation, UAT, deployment, and monitoring

• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPI to measure process effectiveness and improvements outcomes

• Support change management activities and ensure successful adoption of new processes and operating models

• Ensure that proposed changes comply with regulatory framework, internal policies and risk management

• Document processes, procedures and target operating models

• Your Profile
• Master’s degree in finance or Information Technology

• Minimum 10 years of experience in Banking Operations

• Proven experience in process review, process re-engineering or continuous improvement initiatives

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

• Strong communication and stakeholders management skills across all organisational levels

• Ability to work independently and challenge the status quo constructively

• Hands-on experience partnering with Data/IT on AI or advanced automation initiatives in an Operations context

• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma; Business Process Management or similar methodologies is a strong advantage

• Fluent in French and English; any other language would be a plus

• Excellent knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite especially Excel, programming skills is a plus

• Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Team player

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Function purpose: The Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and leading the implementation of enterprise cloud and workplace solutions across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. This strategic and technical leadership role combines Cloud Architecture, Modern Workplace, Security, Identity, Collaboration, and Infrastructure expertise to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and user-centric digital services.
The Architect leads the cloud committee which represent an authority of approval for new cloud service adoption and deployment within the group

• Main responsibilities

Cloud Strategy & Architecture
• Define and maintain the enterprise Microsoft Cloud strategy and roadmap.
• Design secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-effective cloud architectures.
• Ensure cloud solutions align with business objectives, security requirements, and compliance standards.
• Establish Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance models.
 Digital Workplace Architecture
• Define the Digital Workplace vision and architecture.
• Design collaboration and productivity platforms using Microsoft 365.
• Lead workplace transformation initiatives supporting hybrid and remote work.
• Improve employee productivity and digital experience through innovative workplace services.
 Identity, Security & Compliance
• Architect enterprise identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.
• Define and implement Zero Trust security principles.
• Design Conditional Access, Identity Governance, MFA, and Privileged Access Management.
• Establish security controls mastering: Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Protection.
 Ensure compliance with industry regulations and corporate policies.
 Endpoint & Device Management
• Define modern endpoint management strategy.
• Lead Microsoft Intune initiative.
• Implement: Windows Autopilot, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), Endpoint Security, Device Compliance Policies
 Technical Leadership
• Act as the senior technical authority for Cloud and Workplace technologies.
• Lead architecture review boards and technical governance committees.
• Define engineering standards and best practices.
• Serve as escalation point for critical technical issues.

• Your Profile

• Qualifications and Skills
• 10+ years of IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and Workplace Services experience.
• 5+ years designing Azure cloud solutions.
• 5+ years architecting Microsoft 365 enterprise environments.
• Proven leadership of digital transformation and cloud migration programs.
• Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud and workplace platforms.
• Strong background in security, compliance, and identity management.

• Required Technical Skills
• Cloud Technologies: Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Monitor, Azure Backup & Recovery, Azure Governance, Azure Cost Management.
• Microsoft 365: Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.
• Security & Identity: Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Zero Trust Architecture
• Endpoint Management: Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, Mobile Device Management
• Automation & DevOps: PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph API

• Preferred Certifications:
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate

• Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Control-M Batch Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, maintain and optimize scheduling batch workflows for production and test environment (production, uat, …) for a leading banking environment

• Ensure high availability, performance, compliance, and security of end‑to‑end processing chains supporting payments, treasury, accounting, risk, and regulatory reporting.

• Deal with different projects at the same time liaising with different technical stakeholders

• Industrialize a multi-application billing chain with prerequisites, windows, and alerting.

• Migrate job estate to Control-M Automation API + GitOps workflow.

• Maintain and update Documentation

Key Responsibilities

• Design & Industrialization
• Analyze business/IT needs and model workflows in Control-M (Jobs, Folders, Calendars, Conditions, Resources, Variables).

• Apply scheduling standards (naming, reuse, conventions).

• Automate job deployments via Control-M Application Integrator, CTM/CLI, and Automation API.

• Operations & Monitoring
• Perform daily follow-up of batches, critical jobs, SLAs, and processing windows.

• Handle production incidents (diagnosis, restart/recovery, escalation, RCA).

• Optimize runtimes, parallelism, windows, and capacity.

• Integration & DevOps
• Integrate Control-M with CI/CD (Automation API, CTM/CLI, Jenkins/GitLab CI, artifact repos).

• Package and version Control-M objects (JSON, Git).

• Document pipelines, recovery procedures, and runbooks.

• Security & Compliance
• Comply, operate and leverage the Bank’s security framework and conforming to the published security applications RACI matrix provided to all stakeholders.

• Manage access and roles (Control-M/EM, LDAP/AD).

• Apply security policies (encryption, audit, traceability).

• Contribute to audits, risk management, and continuity planning (DR/BCP).

Technical Environnent

• BMC Control-M : V9.21/9.22 Control-M/EM, Server, Agents, Workload Archiving, Automation API, CTM/CLI, Application Integrator, MFT/MFT-E

• Systems : Linux/Unix, Windows Server; z/OS knowledge a plus.

• Scripting & Languages : Shell/Bash, PowerShell, Python, SQL.

• Databases : PostgreSQL (queries, DB job scheduling).

• Middleware & Cloud : FTP/SFTP, REST/Web Services, MQ; AWS/Azure/GCP integration (Control-M for Cloud, Agents).

• CI/CD & SCM : Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, JSON artifacts, automated testing/deployments.

• Monitoring : Integration with tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Splunk, Centreon.

• Security : LDAP/AD, credential management (e.g., Vault, Control-M Secrets).

Required Skills

• Mastery of Control-M scheduling (design, conditions, calendars, resources, alerting).

• Hands-on with Automation API and CTM/CLI for “jobs as code”.

• Scripting for automation and remediation.

• Understanding of batch application architectures and production constraints.

• Incident and problem management , RCA writing and corrective actions.

• Clear communication with RUN, DEV, and business teams.

Profile

• Bachelor’s/ Master’s in computer science (or equivalent experience).

• 5+ years’ experience with Control-M in production environments.

• BMC Control-M and/or ITIL certifications preferred.

• Fluent French/English required.

Soft Skills

• Rigor, service-oriented mindset, reliability in 24/7 contexts.

• Proactive, analytical, and problem-solving approach.

• Teamwork across Production, Development, and SecOps.

• Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing habits.

Work Conditions

• Possible on-call duty, and off-hours interventions based on criticality.

• Location: Geneva

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
Mission
 As an IT Officer dedicated to Level 2 / Level 3 support in the Client Facing area, your primary mission is to support Level 1 support in e-Banking issue identification and resolution. Your mission also encompasses working on tools to ease support and work with the client facing team to ensure the stability, availability and continuous improvement of the Bank’s e Banking platforms (Web and Mobile). You will investigate and resolve complex incidents, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and contribute to the reliability and performance of client-facing digital services in a demanding Private Banking environment.
 Main duties
 • Provide L2/L3 support for the e‑Banking Web and Mobile platforms, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Perform in‑depth technical analysis and troubleshooting across a complex, multi‑tier architecture (front-end, middleware, back-end, interfaces).
• Analyze, reproduce and deep dive issues using logs, monitoring tools and SQL queries on underlying databases.
• Act as a point of escalation for the Service Desk and L1 support teams, providing guidance and knowledge transfer.
• Coordinate with development teams, infrastructure teams and vendors to resolve problems and implement sustainable fixes.
• Participate in problem management: root cause analysis, documentation of known errors, and definition of workarounds and permanent solutions.
• Contribute to change management: impact analysis, preparation and validation of changes affecting the e‑Banking platforms.
• Participate in and sometimes lead testing activities (functional and technical), including regression tests after releases or infrastructure changes.
• Monitor the health and performance of the e‑Banking platforms, proactively identifying risks and proposing improvements.
• Ensure that all activities comply with security, data confidentiality and regulatory requirements of Private Banking.
• Maintain and improve operational documentation (runbooks, procedures, knowledge base articles).
• Collaborate closely with business teams and front-office to understand client impact and priorities; experience with direct client contact is highly appreciated.
• Participate in on‑call / standby rotations when required to support business‑critical services. Some week-end activities are possible.
 Core competencies
• Autonomous, reliable, accountable, well‑organized and pragmatic.
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to deep dive into complex technical issues.
• High sense of service and client orientation; comfortable interacting with demanding internal stakeholders and, when needed, end clients.
• Strong communication skills, able to explain complex issues in a clear and structured way.
• Experience and sensitivity regarding security and data confidentiality.
• Ability to work under pressure, manage priorities and meet deadlines.
• Team player, collaborative, open‑minded and adaptable.
• Able to take responsibility and initiatives, propose improvements and challenge the status quo constructively.
• Integrity of character, discipline and determination.
• Diplomatic, with the ability to manage conflicts and align different stakeholders.
• Fluent in English and French; any additional language is a strong plus.
 Specific competencies
• Solid experience in L2/L3 application support for Web and/or Mobile platforms, ideally in Banking or Financial Services.
• Good knowledge of relational databases and SQL for querying, analysis and troubleshooting (e.g. MS SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent).
• Familiarity with web technologies and architectures (HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, reverse proxies, load balancers, certificates).
• Understanding of mobile application ecosystems (iOS/Android apps, push notifications, app distribution, integration with back-end services).
• Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. application logs, APM, infrastructure monitoring, dashboards, alerting).
• Experience with incident, problem and change management tools and processes (e.g. JIRA/ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools).
• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and software lifecycle management is an asset.
• Experience with Unix/Linux and/or Windows server environments for application support is a plus.
• Awareness of security best practices for internet-facing applications (authentication, authorization, encryption, OWASP concepts).
• Experience in Private Banking or Wealth Management is a strong plus.
• Any additional scripting or development skills (e.g. PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, basic API testing) are considered an advantage.

Other Skills/Abilities
• Swiss residency is mandatory for this position.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione
In qualità di Responsabile IT dedicato al supporto Livello 2 / Livello 3 nell'area di Customer Facing, la vostra missione primaria è quella di supportare il supporto Livello 1 nell'identificazione e nella risoluzione dei problemi di e-Banking. La vostra missione comprende anche lavorare su strumenti per facilitare il supporto e lavorare con il team di fronte al cliente per garantire la stabilità, la disponibilità e il miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme e Banking della Banca (Web e Mobile). Indagherai e risolverai incidenti complessi, coordinati con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, e contribuirai all'affidabilità e alle prestazioni dei servizi digitali orientati al cliente in un ambiente di Private Banking esigente.
Principali compiti
• Fornire il supporto L2/L3 per le piattaforme e‐Banking Web e Mobile, garantendo una risoluzione tempestiva di incidenti e richieste di assistenza.
• Eseguire l'analisi tecnica approfondita e la risoluzione dei problemi attraverso un'architettura complessa e multi-tier (front-end, middleware, back-end, interfacce).
• Analizzare, riprodurre e approfondire i problemi di immersione utilizzando log, strumenti di monitoraggio e query SQL su database sottostanti.
• Agire come punto di escalation per i team di supporto Service Desk e L1, fornendo assistenza e trasferimento di conoscenze.
• Coordinate con team di sviluppo, team di infrastrutture e fornitori per risolvere i problemi e implementare soluzioni sostenibili.
• Partecipazione alla gestione dei problemi: analisi causa radice, documentazione di errori noti, definizione di soluzioni di lavoro e soluzioni permanenti.
• Contribuire alla gestione dei cambiamenti: analisi degli impatti, preparazione e validazione delle modifiche che interessano le piattaforme e‐Banking.
• Partecipare a e a volte condurre attività di test (funzionali e tecnici), compresi i test di regressione dopo le versioni o le modifiche delle infrastrutture.
• Monitorare la salute e le prestazioni delle piattaforme e-Banking, identificare proattivamente i rischi e proporre miglioramenti.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le attività siano conformi ai requisiti di sicurezza, riservatezza dei dati e regolamentazione di Private Banking.
• Mantenere e migliorare la documentazione operativa (runbook, procedure, articoli di base di conoscenza).
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team aziendali e il front-office per comprendere l'impatto e le priorità del cliente; l'esperienza con il contatto diretto del cliente è molto apprezzata.
• Partecipa a rotazione on-call/standby quando necessario per supportare i servizi business-critical. Alcune attività di fine settimana sono possibili.
Competenze fondamentali
• Autonoma, affidabile, responsabile, ben organizzato e pragmatico.
• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving, con la capacità di immergersi in problemi tecnici complessi.
• Alto senso di servizio e orientamento del cliente; confortevole interazione con gli stakeholder interni esigenti e, quando necessario, clienti finali.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, in grado di spiegare questioni complesse in modo chiaro e strutturato.
• Esperienza e sensibilità per la sicurezza e la riservatezza dei dati.
• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione, gestire le priorità e rispettare le scadenze.
• Giocatore di squadra, collaborativo, aperto e adattabile.
• In grado di assumere responsabilità e iniziative, proporre miglioramenti e sfidare lo status quo costruttivamente.
• Integrità di carattere, disciplina e determinazione.
• Diplomatico, con la capacità di gestire i conflitti e allineare i diversi stakeholder.
• Fluente in inglese e francese; qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un vantaggio forte.
Competenze specifiche
• Esperienza solida nel supporto dell'applicazione L2/L3 per piattaforme Web e/o Mobile, idealmente nei servizi bancari o finanziari.
• Buona conoscenza dei database relazionali e SQL per querying, analisi e risoluzione dei problemi (ad esempio MS SQL Server, Oracle, o equivalente).
• Familiarità con tecnologie web e architetture (HTTP/HTTPS, REST API, proxy inversa, bilanciatori di carico, certificati).
• Comprensione degli ecosistemi delle applicazioni mobili (app iOS/Android, notifiche push, distribuzione delle app, integrazione con i servizi back-end).
• Esperienza con strumenti di monitoraggio e registrazione (ad esempio log delle applicazioni, APM, monitoraggio delle infrastrutture, dashboard, allerta).
• Esperienza con strumenti e processi di gestione degli incidenti, dei problemi e dei cambiamenti (ad esempio JIRA/ServiceNow o strumenti ITSM equivalenti).
• La conoscenza delle pipeline CI/CD e la gestione del ciclo di vita del software è un bene.
• L'esperienza con ambienti server Unix/Linux e/o Windows per il supporto delle applicazioni è un vantaggio.
• Consapevolezza delle best practice di sicurezza per le applicazioni Internet-facing (autenticità, autorizzazione, crittografia, concetti OWASP).
• L'esperienza in Private Banking o Wealth Management è un vantaggio forte.
• Eventuali ulteriori abilità di scrittura o sviluppo (ad esempio PowerShell, Python, scripting shell, test API di base) sono considerati un vantaggio.

Altre abilità/abilità
• La residenza svizzera è obbligatoria per questa posizione.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsteams und Front-Office, um die Auswirkungen und Prioritäten der Kunden zu verstehen; Erfahrung mit direktem Kundenkontakt wird sehr geschätzt.
• Nehmen Sie an On-Call-/Standby-Rotationen teil, wenn dies zur Unterstützung geschäftskritischer Dienste erforderlich ist. Einige Wochenendaktivitäten sind möglich.
Kernkompetenzen
• Autonom, zuverlässig, rechenschaftspflichtig, gut organisiert und pragmatisch.
• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, tief in komplexe technische Probleme einzutauchen.
• Hoher Sinn für Service und Kundenorientierung; komfortable Interaktion mit anspruchsvollen internen Stakeholdern und bei Bedarf mit Endkunden.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, komplexe Themen klar und strukturiert zu erklären.
• Erfahrung und Sensibilität in Bezug auf Sicherheit und Vertraulichkeit der Daten.
• Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten, Prioritäten zu verwalten und Termine einzuhalten.
• Teamplayer, kollaborativ, aufgeschlossen und anpassungsfähig.
• Fähigkeit, Verantwortung und Initiativen zu übernehmen, Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen und den Status quo konstruktiv in Frage zu stellen.
• Integrität des Charakters, Disziplin und Entschlossenheit.
• Diplomatisch, mit der Fähigkeit, Konflikte zu bewältigen und verschiedene Interessengruppen zusammenzubringen.
• Fließend Englisch und Französisch; jede zusätzliche Sprache ist ein starkes Plus.
Spezifische Kompetenzen
• Solide Erfahrung in der L2/L3-Anwendungsunterstützung für Web- und/oder Mobile-Plattformen, idealerweise im Bank- oder Finanzwesen.
• Gute Kenntnisse in relationalen Datenbanken und SQL für Abfrage, Analyse und Fehlersuche (z. B. MS SQL Server, Oracle oder gleichwertig).
• Vertrautheit mit Web-Technologien und -Architekturen (HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, Reverse Proxies, Load Balancer, Zertifikate).
• Verständnis von Ökosystemen für mobile Anwendungen (iOS/Android-Apps, Push-Benachrichtigungen, App-Verteilung, Integration mit Backend-Diensten).
• Erfahrung mit Überwachungs- und Protokollierungstools (z. B. Anwendungsprotokolle, APM, Infrastrukturüberwachung, Dashboards, Alarmierung).
• Erfahrung mit Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management-Tools und -Prozessen (z. B. JIRA/ServiceNow oder gleichwertige ITSM-Tools).
• Kenntnisse über CI/CD-Pipelines und Software-Lifecycle-Management sind eine Bereicherung.
• Die Erfahrung mit Unix/Linux und/oder Windows-Serverumgebungen für die Anwendungsunterstützung ist ein Plus.
• Sensibilisierung für bewährte Sicherheitspraktiken für internetgestützte Anwendungen (Authentifizierung, Autorisierung, Verschlüsselung, OWASP-Konzepte).
• Erfahrung im Private Banking oder Wealth Management ist ein starkes Plus.
• Zusätzliche Scripting- oder Entwicklungsfähigkeiten (z. B. PowerShell, Python, Shell-Scripting, grundlegende API-Tests) werden als Vorteil angesehen.

Sonstige Fähigkeiten/Fähigkeiten
• Der Schweizer Wohnsitz ist für diese Position obligatorisch.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission
En tant qu'agent de TI affecté au soutien de niveau 2 / niveau 3 dans le domaine de la prise en charge des clients, votre mission principale est de soutenir le soutien de niveau 1 dans l'identification et la résolution des problèmes de banque électronique. Votre mission comprend également le travail sur des outils pour faciliter le soutien et le travail avec l'équipe client pour assurer la stabilité, la disponibilité et l'amélioration continue des plateformes bancaires de la Banque (Web et Mobile). Vous enquêterez sur les incidents complexes et les résoudreez, vous coordonnerez avec les intervenants internes et externes, et vous contribuerez à la fiabilité et à la performance des services numériques orientés vers le client dans un environnement de banque privée exigeant.
Fonctions principales
• Fournir un soutien L2/L3 pour les plateformes Web et mobiles de banque électronique, en assurant le règlement rapide des incidents et des demandes de service.
• Effectuer une analyse technique approfondie et dépanner une architecture complexe et multi-niveaux (avant-garde, intergiciel, back-end, interfaces).
• Analyser, reproduire et résoudre les problèmes de plongée profonde à l'aide de journaux, d'outils de surveillance et de requêtes SQL sur les bases de données sous-jacentes.
• Agir comme un point d'escalade pour les équipes de soutien du Service Desk et de L1, en fournissant des conseils et en transférant des connaissances.
• Coordonner avec les équipes de développement, les équipes d'infrastructure et les fournisseurs pour résoudre les problèmes et mettre en œuvre des solutions durables.
• Participer à la gestion des problèmes : analyse des causes profondes, documentation des erreurs connues, définition des solutions de rechange et des solutions permanentes.
• Contribuer à la gestion du changement : analyse d'impact, préparation et validation des changements touchant les plateformes de banque électronique.
• Participer aux activités d'essais (fonctionnels et techniques) et parfois les diriger, y compris les essais de régression après les rejets ou les changements d'infrastructure.
• Surveiller la santé et le rendement des plateformes de banque électronique, identifier les risques de façon proactive et proposer des améliorations.
• Veiller à ce que toutes les activités respectent la sécurité, la confidentialité des données et les exigences réglementaires de Private Banking.
• Maintenir et améliorer la documentation opérationnelle (livres de bord, procédures, articles de base de connaissances).
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'affaires et le bureau principal pour comprendre l'impact et les priorités des clients; l'expérience des contacts directs avec les clients est très appréciée.
• Participer aux rotations sur appel ou en attente au besoin pour soutenir les services essentiels aux entreprises. Certaines activités de week-end sont possibles.
Compétences de base
• Autonome, fiable, responsable, bien organisé et pragmatique.
• De solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de plonger profondément dans des questions techniques complexes.
• Sensation de service élevée et orientation des clients; interaction confortable avec les intervenants internes exigeants et, au besoin, avec les clients finaux.
• Fortes compétences en communication, capables d'expliquer les questions complexes de manière claire et structurée.
• Expérience et sensibilité en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité des données.
• Capacité de travailler sous pression, de gérer les priorités et de respecter les échéances.
• Joueur d'équipe, collaboratif, ouvert d'esprit et adaptable.
• Peut prendre des responsabilités et prendre des initiatives, proposer des améliorations et remettre en question le statu quo de manière constructive.
• Intégrité du caractère, discipline et détermination.
• Diplomatique, capable de gérer les conflits et d'aligner les différentes parties prenantes.
• Fluent en anglais et en français; toute autre langue est un plus fort.
Compétences spécifiques
• Solide expérience en support d'application L2/L3 pour les plateformes Web et/ou Mobile, idéalement dans les services bancaires ou financiers.
• Bonne connaissance des bases de données relationnelles et SQL pour la requête, l'analyse et le dépannage (par exemple MS SQL Server, Oracle, ou équivalent).
• Familiarité avec les technologies et les architectures web (HTTP/HTTPS, API REST, proxy inverse, balanceurs de charge, certificats).
• Compréhension des écosystèmes d'applications mobiles (applications iOS/Android, notifications push, distribution d'applications, intégration avec les services back-end).
• Expérience des outils de surveillance et d'enregistrement (p. ex. journaux d'application, APM, surveillance de l'infrastructure, tableaux de bord, alerte).
• Expérience des outils et des processus de gestion des incidents, des problèmes et des changements (p. ex. JIRA/ServiceNow ou des outils de gestion des TI équivalents).
• La connaissance des pipelines CI/CD et de la gestion du cycle de vie des logiciels est un atout.
• Expérience avec les environnements de serveur Unix/Linux et/ou Windows pour le support des applications est un plus.
• Connaissance des pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité pour les applications faisant face à Internet (authentification, autorisation, cryptage, concepts OWASP).
• L'expérience en banque privée ou en gestion de patrimoine est un plus fort.
• Toute compétence supplémentaire de script ou de développement (p. ex. PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, test d'API de base) est considérée comme un avantage.

Autres compétences
• La résidence suisse est obligatoire pour ce poste.

jobs.description:
• Mission

• Design, deploy, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift platforms

• Adapt and optimize OpenShift clusters (filesystem management, access control, quotas, policies) on underlying Unix/Linux systems.

• Install, migrate, and operate Unix/Linux environments according to our standards and processes.

• Plan and manage system storage and related capacity (including persistence of OpenShift volumes).

• Ensure security, resilience, and compliance across environments.

• Participate in on-call rotations.
 Challenges

• Adapt to heterogeneous environments (AIX/Solaris/RHEL, virtualization) and existing processes.

• Align Unix/Linux operations practices with container, Kubernetes, and OpenShift paradigms.

• Support application migrations to OpenShift with minimal impact, while meeting financial-sector security requirements.

• Main responsibilities
 General competencies

• Knowledge of major Unix/Linux distributions: IBM AIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Solaris.

• Proven experience deploying and operating OpenShift or Kubernetes in production.

• Understanding of storage and network technologies: memory, disk arrays, NAS/SAN, networking (TCP/IP, VLAN, load balancing).

• Understanding of database concepts: maintenance, recovery, failover, high availability.

• Understanding of routine maintenance, recovery, and handling failover of a Database

• Familiarity with at least one enterprise backup solution (e.g., NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam).
 Specific competencies

• Install, configure, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift clusters (IPI/UPI, bare metal/virtualized/cloud).

• Mastery of Kubernetes/OpenShift concepts: projects, routes, services, deployments, statefulsets, operators, CRD, RBAC, SCC, NetworkPolicy.

• OpenShift lifecycle management: controlled upgrades, patches, channels, image mirroring, oc CLI.

• Security and compliance:

• Configuration of RBAC, SCC, PSa/PSP equivalents, secrets, encryption.

• OIDC/SAML integration with IdPs (e.g., Keycloak, Azure AD).

• Policies and admission control (Gatekeeper/OPA), auditing, hardening.

• OpenShift networking:

• CNI (OpenShiftSDN/OVNK), ingress/egress, routes, load balancers, service mesh (Istio/Service Mesh).

• Storage and persistence:

• Provisioning PersistentVolume/PersistentVolumeClaim, StorageClasses, CSI drivers, NAS/SAN integration (NFS, Ceph, …).

• Observability:

• Logging and metrics (Cluster Logging, Loki/EFK, Prometheus/Grafana), alerting, SIEM integration.

• CI/CD and images:

• BuildConfigs/ImageStreams, registry management (Quay/Artifactory), image policies.

• Operations and SRE:

• Cluster and application backup/restore (Velero, etcd backup).

• Capacity planning, autoscaling (HPA/VPA/Cluster Autoscaler), performance tuning.

• Troubleshooting: pods, nodes, networking, storage, scheduling.

Primary Responsibilities

• Install and configure OpenShift components and RHEL and Unix OSes to host workloads.

• Deploy, maintain, and upgrade OpenShift clusters and their operators.

• Apply and test OS and platform patches; manage compliance and hardening.

• Develop and implement security and management procedures (OS and OpenShift).

• Update standard policies based on environmental changes and audit findings.

• Improve system and cluster performance; propose optimization initiatives.

• Identify, diagnose, and resolve system and platform incidents (L2/L3).

• Plan, coordinate, and execute installation, testing, and maintenance of system software and OpenShift components.

• Lead projects within approved timelines, including migrations to OpenShift and workload rationalization.

• Analyze software and hardware environments to detect defects and risks; propose remediations.

• Maintain up-to-date documentation: architecture, operator procedures, component inventory, runbooks.

• Implement backup and recovery strategies (OS, etcd, applications) and validate their effectiveness.

• Implement and test disaster recovery and business continuity (DR/BCP) procedures for OS and OpenShift.

• Perform performance maintenance routines to ensure continuous availability.

• Your Profile

• Years of experience: 3–7.

• Financial sector: preferred.

• Required experience:

• Minimum 3 years as Unix/Linux systems administrator.

• Required knowledge:

• OS: RHEL, OpenShift.

• Storage, memory, disk arrays, NAS/SAN, networking (DNS, TLS, firewalling)

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione

• Progettazione, distribuzione e manutenzione delle piattaforme Red Hat OpenShift

• Adapt e ottimizzare i cluster OpenShift (gestione filesystem, controllo accessi, quote, politiche) sui sistemi Unix/Linux sottostanti.

• Installare, migrare e utilizzare ambienti Unix/Linux secondo i nostri standard e processi.

• Pianificare e gestire lo storage di sistema e la relativa capacità (compresa la persistenza dei volumi OpenShift).

• Assicurare sicurezza, resilienza e conformità in ambienti.

• Partecipa a rotazioni su chiamata.
Sfide

• Adapt ad ambienti eterogenei (AIX/Solaris/RHEL, virtualizzazione) e processi esistenti.

• Allineare le pratiche operative Unix/Linux con i paradigmi di container, Kubernetes e OpenShift.

• Supporta le migrazioni delle applicazioni a OpenShift con un impatto minimo, soddisfando i requisiti di sicurezza del settore finanziario.

• Principali responsabilità
Competenze generali

• Conoscenza delle principali distribuzioni Unix/Linux: IBM AIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Solaris.

• Esperienza comprovata di distribuzione e funzionamento di OpenShift o Kubernetes in produzione.

• Comprensione delle tecnologie di archiviazione e di rete: memoria, array di dischi, NAS/SAN, networking (TCP/IP, VLAN, bilanciamento del carico).

• Comprensione dei concetti del database: manutenzione, recupero, failover, elevata disponibilità.

• Comprensione della manutenzione ordinaria, del recupero e del mancato funzionamento di un database

• Familiarità con almeno una soluzione di backup aziendale (ad esempio NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam).
Competenze specifiche

• Installare, configurare e mantenere cluster Red Hat OpenShift (IPI/UPI, metallo nudo/virtualizzato/cloud).

• Mastery of Kubernetes/OpenShift concept: progetti, percorsi, servizi, distribuzioni, statefulset, operatori, CRD, RBAC, SCC, NetworkPolicy.

• Gestione del ciclo di vita OpenShift: aggiornamenti controllati, patch, canali, mirroring delle immagini, oc CLI.

• Sicurezza e conformità:

• Configurazione degli equivalenti RBAC, SCC, PSa/PSP, segreti, crittografia.

• Integrazione OIDC/SAML con IdPs (ad esempio, Keycloak, Azure AD).

• Politiche e controllo di ammissione (Gatekeeper/OPA), auditing, indurimento.

• OpenShift networking:

• CNI (OpenShiftSDN/OVNK), ingresso/uscita, percorsi, bilanciatori di carico, rete di servizio (Istio/Service Mesh).

• Conservazione e persistenza:

• Fornitura di PersistentVolume/PersistentVolumeClaim, StorageClasses, driver CSI, integrazione NAS/SAN (NFS, Ceph, ...).

• Osservabilità:

• Registrazione e metriche (Logging cluster, Loki/EFK, Prometheus/Grafana), allerta, integrazione SIEM.

• CI/CD e immagini:

• BuildConfigs/ImageStreams, gestione del registro di sistema (Quay/Artifactory), politiche dell'immagine.

• Operazioni e SRE:

• Cluster e applicazione backup/restore (Velero, eccd backup).

• Pianificazione della capacità, autoscaling (HPA/VPA/Cluster Autoscaler), regolazione delle prestazioni.

• Risoluzione dei problemi: pod, nodi, networking, storage, pianificazione.

Responsabilità primaria

• Installare e configurare componenti OpenShift e sistemi operativi RHEL e Unix per ospitare carichi di lavoro.

• Distribuire, mantenere e aggiornare i cluster OpenShift e i loro operatori.

• Applicare e testare le patch del sistema operativo e della piattaforma; gestire la conformità e indurimento.

• Sviluppare e implementare procedure di sicurezza e gestione (OS e OpenShift).

• Aggiornare le politiche standard basate su cambiamenti ambientali e risultati di audit.

• Migliorare le prestazioni di sistema e cluster; proporre iniziative di ottimizzazione.

• Identificare, diagnosticare e risolvere gli incidenti del sistema e della piattaforma (L2/L3).

• Pianificare, coordinare ed eseguire l'installazione, il test e la manutenzione di software di sistema e componenti OpenShift.

• Progetti di piombo all'interno di linee temporali approvate, comprese le migrazioni a OpenShift e razionalizzazione del carico di lavoro.

• Analizzare gli ambienti software e hardware per rilevare difetti e rischi; proporre correzioni.

• Mantenere la documentazione aggiornata: architettura, procedure operatore, inventario dei componenti, runbook.

• Implementare le strategie di backup e ripristino (OS, eccd, applicazioni) e convalidare la loro efficacia.

• Implementare e testare il ripristino dei disastri e la continuità aziendale (DR/BCP) procedure per OS e OpenShift.

• Eseguire routine di manutenzione delle prestazioni per garantire la disponibilità continua.

• Il tuo profilo

• Anni di esperienza: 3-7.

• Settore finanziario: preferito.

• Esperienza richiesta:

• Minimo 3 anni come amministratore di sistemi Unix/Linux.

• Conoscenza richiesta:

• OS: RHEL, OpenShift.

• Storage, memoria, array di dischi, NAS/SAN, networking (DNS, TLS, firewalling)

• Altri
• Residenza svizzera

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.description:
Mission :
As a QA Engineer, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our private banking e-banking platforms. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies across web and mobile channels, drive operational excellence in manual and automated testing, and ensure full alignment with regulatory and data privacy requirements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Strategy & Planning
• Design and implement risk-based test strategies aligned to project timelines, scope, and regulatory constraints.

• Define and maintain test plans covering functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing.

• Test Execution (Manual & Automated)
• Execute test cases and end-to-end scenarios across web and mobile e-banking journeys (onboarding, payments, trading, client communications, alerts).

• Operate and execute existing automation packs

• Exposure to automated testing tools or frameworks like Selenium, Playwright is a plus, CI pipelines, and test management tools (JIRA X-Ray)

• Analyze logs and results to triage failures.

• Validate back-end behavior via SQL queries, API validations, and log analysis.

• Quality Governance & Reporting
• Enforce QA standards, test traceability, and documentation across the SDLC.

• Use JIRA and Xray for test management, traceability, defect lifecycle, and coverage reporting.

• Provide concise QA dashboards and KPIs to QA Lead, Release Management, and Project Management.

• Defect & Risk Management
• Log, prioritize, and track defects; facilitate triage with Development, DevOps, and Business.

• Ensure clean entry/exit criteria by release; contribute to go/no-go decisions.

• UAT & Stakeholder Collaboration
• Co-define UAT strategy with business stakeholders, document acceptance criteria and success metrics.

• Support UAT execution, defect triage, and sign-off readiness.

• Continuous Improvement
• Drive process improvements in test design, data management, and automation reliability; contribute to playbooks and reusable assets.

Required Technical Proficiency :

• Test Operations
• Strong experience executing manual and automated tests across web and mobile in an Agile environment.

• Hands-on with test management using JIRA and Xray (test plans, executions, traceability to requirements and defects).

• Basic understanding of version control workflows (Git) for fetching branches and running tagged suites.

• Data & API Validation
• Proficient in SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and back-end testing.

• Experience validating REST APIs (e.g., Postman, Swagger, etc..) and reviewing application logs.

• Tooling
• Defect tracking and reporting using JIRA; test design and execution in Xray is essential.

• Analytics/reporting on test KPIs and coverage using Xray/JIRA dashboards or BI tools.

Preferred Skills :

• Financial Services
• 5+ years in banking, ideally Private Banking/Wealth Management; solid grasp of payments, trading flows, client onboarding/KYC, and portfolio reporting.

• Technical
• Exposure to automation tools (e.g., Selenium) and familiarity with languages like Java or Python is preferred for reading test code and interpreting failures.

• Experience with mobile testing (e.g., Appium) and cross-browser/device testing.

• Process
• Experience defining UAT strategies, test data management, and environment orchestration.

Soft Skills :

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented, risk-aware mindset.

• Clear, concise communicator; able to translate complex technical findings for business stakeholders.

• Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable facilitating cross-team triage.

• Adaptable, with a continuous learning mindset and ownership of quality outcomes.

Languages :

• Proficiency in French and English required; German is a plus.

Education :

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Potrai progettare ed eseguire strategie di test complete su canali web e mobili, guidare l'eccellenza operativa in test manuali e automatizzati, e garantire l'allineamento completo con le normative e i requisiti di privacy dei dati.

• Principali responsabilità

• Strategia e pianificazione
• Progettare e implementare strategie di test basate sui rischi allineate a tempi di progetto, portata e vincoli normativi.

• Definire e mantenere i piani di prova che coprono test funzionali, integrazione, sistema, prestazioni e regressione.

• Esecuzione test (Manuale e Automatizzato)
• Eseguire casi di test e scenari end-to-end attraverso viaggi web e mobile e-banking (a bordo, pagamenti, trading, comunicazioni client, avvisi).

• Operare ed eseguire i pacchetti di automazione esistenti

• Esposizione a strumenti di prova automatizzati o quadri come Selenium, Playwright è un plus, CI pipelines e strumenti di gestione dei test (JIRA X-Ray)

• Analizzare i log e i risultati dei guasti di triage.

• Convalida il comportamento di back-end tramite query SQL, convalida API e analisi di log.

• Gestione della Qualità & Reporting
• Applicare gli standard QA, la tracciabilità dei test e la documentazione sullo SDLC.

• Utilizzare JIRA e Xray per la gestione dei test, tracciabilità, ciclo di vita difettoso e report di copertura.

• Fornire dashboard QA concisi e KPI a QA Lead, Gestione dei comunicati e Project Management.

• Gestione dei difetti e dei rischi
• Log, priorità e tracciare i difetti; facilitare il triage con lo sviluppo, DevOps e Business.

• Assicurare criteri di entrata/uscita puliti per rilascio; contribuire a decisioni di go/no-go.

• UAT & Stakeholder Collaborazione
• Codefinire la strategia UAT con gli stakeholder aziendali, i criteri di accettazione dei documenti e le metriche di successo.

• Supporta l'esecuzione UAT, il triage difettoso e la prontezza di segnale.

• Miglioramento continuo

• Miglioramento del processo di guida nella progettazione di test, nella gestione dei dati e nell'affidabilità dell'automazione; contribuire ai playbook e alle attività riutilizzabili.

• Competenza tecnica richiesta

• Operazioni di test
• Forte esperienza eseguendo test manuali e automatizzati su web e mobile in un ambiente Agile.

• Hands-on con gestione dei test utilizzando JIRA e Xray (progetti di prova, esecuzioni, tracciabilità a requisiti e difetti).

• Comprensione di base dei flussi di lavoro di controllo della versione (Git) per l'acquisizione di rami e l'esecuzione di suite etichettate.

• Convalida dati e API
• Proficiente in SQL per la convalida dei dati, la riconciliazione e il test back-end.

• Esperienza validazione delle API REST (ad esempio, Postman, Swagger, ecc.) e revisione dei registri delle applicazioni.

• Strumenti

• Difetti di tracciamento e reporting utilizzando JIRA; la progettazione e l'esecuzione di test in Xray è essenziale.

• Analisi/reporting sui KPI di prova e copertura utilizzando dashboard Xray/JIRA o strumenti BI.

• Competenze consigliate

• Servizi finanziari
• 5+ anni nel settore bancario, idealmente Private Banking/Wealth Management; solida comprensione dei pagamenti, flussi di trading, client onboarding/KYC, e reporting portafoglio.

• Tecnica
• L'esposizione agli strumenti di automazione (ad esempio, Selenium) e la familiarità con linguaggi come Java o Python è preferita per la lettura del codice di prova e l'interpretazione dei guasti.

• Esperienza con test mobili (ad esempio, Appium) e test cross-browser/device.

• Processo
• Esperienza nella definizione di strategie UAT, gestione dei dati di prova e orchestrazione dell'ambiente.

• Abilità morbide

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con una mentalità orientata al dettaglio, con attenzione al rischio.

• comunicatore chiaro e conciso; in grado di tradurre complessi risultati tecnici per gli stakeholder aziendali.

• Triage collaborativo, proattivo e confortevole facilitando il cross-team.

• Adattabile, con una mentalità di apprendimento continuo e la proprietà dei risultati di qualità.

• Lingue

• La competenza in francese e inglese richiesto; il tedesco è un plus.

• Istruzione

• Corso di laurea in informatica, sistemi informativi, o relativo campo (o esperienza equivalente).

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.description:
• Mission
 We’re seeking a Senior IT Delivery PMO Manager to enhance and run delivery governance across multiple programs and projects. You will standardize methods, manage cross-team dependencies, and lead an onshore/offshore model to deliver on time and on budget with quality. The role requires hands-on reporting using SQL and Power BI to produce accurate, actionable dashboards for leadership

• Main responsibilities

• Delivery Governance and Standards

• Define, evolve, and enforce delivery frameworks (Agile, hybrid, SDLC), stage gates, templates, and quality criteria.

• Implement baselines and variance management for scope, schedule, and cost.

• Maintain delivery playbooks, RACI, and onboarding for PMs/Scrum Masters across onshore/offshore teams.

• Planning, Scheduling, and Dependencies

• Establish integrated master schedules and release plans; manage cross-team dependencies and critical paths.

• Facilitate PI/quarterly planning with demand intake handoffs to delivery teams.

• Delivery Assurance and Reporting

• Define and Track KPIs/OKRs for delivery health (schedule adherence, burn, velocity, defect density, escaped defects, SLA attainment).

• Build and maintain automated Power BI delivery dashboards; integrate data from Jira/Azure DevOps, time tracking, and finance.

• Ensure accurate, timely status reporting; drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Capacity Utilization Tracking and Governance

• Define utilization standards and taxonomies (direct vs. indirect time, project vs. KT/BAU vs. support); set target bands by role and seniority.

• Implement time-tracking compliance and quality checks; manage policy exceptions (holidays, PTO, training, ramp-down).

• Monitor utilization at individual, team, vendor, and portfolio levels; drive corrective actions for under/over-utilization (rebalancing, backlog grooming, cross-skilling).

• Risk, Issue, and Change Management

• Operate a rigorous RAID process with heatmaps and escalation paths; maintain mitigation and contingency plans.

• Manage change control and traceability from intake to deployment; enforce scope discipline.

• Ensure compliance with security, data governance, SDLC, and audit requirements.

• Financials and Vendor Management

• Track delivery budgets, forecasts, and burn (CapEx/OpEx); partner with Finance on month-end close and accruals.

• Identify cost and productivity improvements (tooling, automation, standardization).

• Update financial systems and ensure consistency across all PMO toolsets.

• Stakeholder Management and Communications

• Facilitate exec readouts on delivery status, risks, and release readiness; present options and recommendations.

• Partner with Business Change, Architecture, Delivery Support and IT Management to align on priorities and release criteria.

• Drive adoption of delivery metrics and continuous improvement programs.

• Your Profile

• Education & Certifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

• Preferred: PMP and/or PgMP; Agile certifications (PSM/CSM, SAFe Agilist/SPC); Power BI or SQL certifications are a plus.

• ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge beneficial.

• Technical Skills

• SQL

• Read, troubleshoot, and update SQL queries for delivery/reporting datasets.

• Proficiency with joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions; exposure to performance tuning basics.

• Experience with SQL Server/Azure SQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL; familiarity with views and stored procedures.

• Power BI

• Build end-to-end delivery dashboards: connect to Jira/Azure DevOps/SQL, model data, create DAX measures, drill-through.

• Implement row-level security, dataflows, scheduled refresh, and workspace governance.

• Design executive-ready storytelling (milestones, burnup/burndown, throughput, defect trends).

• Delivery Tooling & Data

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Tempo and CI/CD release calendars.

• Basic ETL/ELT and data quality practices; Advanced Excel (Power Query, pivots).

• Languages - Fluent in English is mandatory and fluency in French is beneficial

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Missione
Stiamo cercando un senior IT Delivery PMO Manager per migliorare ed eseguire la governance di consegna attraverso più programmi e progetti. standardizzare i metodi, gestire le dipendenze cross-team, e condurre un modello onshore/offshore per consegnare in tempo e sul budget con qualità. Il ruolo richiede report pratici utilizzando SQL e Power BI per produrre dashboard accurati e attuabili per la leadership

• Principali responsabilità

• Governance e standard di consegna

• Definire, evolvere e applicare le strutture di consegna (Agile, ibrido, SDLC), cancelli di fase, modelli e criteri di qualità.

• Implementare le linee di base e la gestione della varianza per la portata, il programma e i costi.

• Mantenere i playbook di consegna, RACI, e a bordo per PM/Scrum Masters attraverso le squadre onshore/offshore.

• Pianificazione, pianificazione e dipendenze

• Istituire master plan integrati e piani di rilascio; gestire dipendenze cross-team e percorsi critici.

• Facilitate PI/quarterly la pianificazione con i handoff di assunzione di richiesta ai team di consegna.

• Assicurazione e segnalazione di consegna

• Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per la salute di consegna (aderenza di taglio, ustione, velocità, densità di difetto, difetti sfuggiti, raggiungimento SLA).

• Costruire e mantenere cruscotti di consegna Power BI automatizzati; integrare i dati da Jira/Azure DevOps, monitoraggio del tempo e finanza.

• Assicurare la segnalazione accurata e tempestiva dello stato; guidare l'analisi root-cause e le azioni correttive.

• Monitoraggio e Governance delle capacità

• Definire gli standard di utilizzo e le tassonomie (ora diretta vs indiretta, progetto vs. KT/BAU vs. supporto); impostare bande di destinazione per ruolo e anzianità.

• Attuazione del tempo-tracking conformità e controlli di qualità; gestire le eccezioni politiche (giorni, PTO, formazione, dilatazione).

• Monitorare l'utilizzo a livello individuale, team, fornitore e portafoglio; guidare azioni correttive per under/over-utilization (riequilibrio, backlog, cross-skilling).

• Gestione dei rischi, problemi e cambiamenti

• Operare un rigoroso processo RAID con mappe di calore e percorsi di escalation; mantenere i piani di mitigazione e contingenza.

• Gestire il controllo del cambiamento e la tracciabilità dall'assunzione all'implementazione; applicare la disciplina di portata.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, governance dei dati, SDLC e audit.

• Gestione finanziaria e dei fornitori

• Bilanci di consegna pista, previsioni e masterizzazione (CapEx/OpEx); partner con Finance su fine mese e accruals.

• Identificare i miglioramenti dei costi e della produttività (tooling, automazione, standardizzazione).

• Aggiornare i sistemi finanziari e garantire la coerenza tra tutti gli strumenti PMO.

• Gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder

• Facilitate exec pronte per lo stato di consegna, i rischi e la disponibilità di rilascio; opzioni e raccomandazioni presenti.

• Partner con Business Change, Architettura, Supporto di Consegna e Gestione IT per allineare le priorità e i criteri di rilascio.

• Guidare l'adozione di metriche di consegna e programmi di miglioramento continuo.

• Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione e Certificazioni

• Corso di laurea in Sistemi Informativi, Business, Finanza, Ingegneria, o relativo campo; grado avanzato un plus.

• Preferito: PMP e/o PgMP; Certificazioni Agile (PSM/CSM, SAFe Agilist/SPC); Le certificazioni Power BI o SQL sono un plus.

• ITIL Foundation o equivalente conoscenza della gestione del servizio benefico.

• Competenze tecniche

• SQL SQL

• Leggere, risolvere i problemi e aggiornare le query SQL per la consegna/reporting datasets.

• Competenza con unitÃ, aggregazioni, CTE, funzioni finestra; esposizione ai principi di messa a punto delle prestazioni.

• Esperienza con SQL Server/Azure SQL, Oracle o PostgreSQL; familiarità con le viste e le procedure memorizzate.

• Potenza BI

• Costruire dashboard di consegna end-to-end: connettersi a Jira/Azure DevOps/SQL, dati di modello, creare misure DAX, trapano.

• Implementare sicurezza a livello di riga, flussi di dati, aggiornamento programmato e governance dello spazio di lavoro.

• Progettazione di narrazione executive-ready (milestones, burnup/burndown, throughput, tendenze difetti).

• Strumenti di consegna e dati

• Esperienza con Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Tempo e CI/CD calendari di rilascio.

• Pratiche di base ETL/ELT e di qualità dei dati; Advanced Excel (Power Query, pivot).

• Lingue - Il fluente in inglese è obbligatorio e la fluenza in francese è benefica

• Altri
• Residenza svizzera

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

 Lead the delivery of a complex, cross-border transformation by turning plans into shipped outcomes. • Main responsibilities
 Integrated Delivery Leadership

• Run the weekly delivery forum: cross-stream dependency sync, risk review, and unblock decisions

jobs.description:
Mission
 We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Functional Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture team. You will play a key role in structuring the bank's data, processes and information flows, ensuring consistency, quality and control across a highly regulated environment supporting wealth management, compliance and reporting.
 What you will do

• Define and validate the bank's enterprise data requirements and their end-to-end lifecycle, from transactional to analytical systems, based on business process analysis.

• Design and maintain a federation of enterprise data models serving as the reference for in-house development and data flows.

• Define golden sources for each business concept and validate the design of data flows.

• Build and maintain functional maps of the information system.

• Allocate functional capabilities across the organisation and applications, working closely with business analysts and solution architects.

• Support actively the governance of the bank's critical data, in line with FINMA Circular 2023/1.

• Define enterprise architecture standards and support their adoption across project and IT teams.
 What you bring

• Senior-level experience in enterprise architecture, ideally gained within a private bank or wealth management institution.

• Strong command of enterprise data modelling and data governance principles.

• Good understanding of Swiss regulatory requirements for banking data, including FINMA Circular 2023/1 on critical data management.

• Experience with functional mapping and business process modelling (BPMN or equivalent).

• Proven ability to collaborate across business, business analysis, solution architecture and IT teams.

• Exposure to modern data architectures (data lake, data warehouse, analytics platforms).

• Understanding of data quality and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.

• Knowledge of wealth management business processes (client onboarding, portfolio management, compliance, reporting).

• Excellent communication skills in French and English.
 Required certifications

• CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) — Practitioner level (Level 2).

• TOGAF certified (or equivalent enterprise architecture certification).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione
Stiamo cercando un Senior Enterprise Functional Architect per unirci al nostro team di Enterprise Architecture. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella strutturazione dei flussi di dati, processi e informazioni della banca, garantendo coerenza, qualità e controllo in un ambiente altamente regolamentato che supporta la gestione della ricchezza, la conformità e la segnalazione.
Cosa farai

• Definire e convalidare i requisiti di dati aziendali della banca e il loro ciclo di vita end-to-end, dai sistemi transazionali ai sistemi analitici, in base all'analisi dei processi aziendali.

• Progettare e mantenere una federazione di modelli di dati aziendali che servono come riferimento per lo sviluppo interno e flussi di dati.

• Definire fonti d'oro per ogni concetto di business e convalidare la progettazione dei flussi di dati.

• Costruisci e mantieni mappe funzionali del sistema informativo.

• Allocare le funzionalità in tutta l'organizzazione e le applicazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli analisti di business e gli architetti di soluzioni.

• Sostenere attivamente la governance dei dati critici della banca, in linea con la FINMA Circular 2023/1.

• Definire gli standard di architettura aziendale e sostenere la loro adozione in team di progetto e IT.
Cosa porti

• Esperienza di livello superiore nell'architettura aziendale, idealmente acquisita all'interno di una banca privata o istituzione di gestione patrimoniale.

• Forte comando della modellazione dei dati aziendali e dei principi di governance dei dati.

• Buona comprensione dei requisiti normativi svizzeri per i dati bancari, tra cui la FINMA Circular 2023/1 sulla gestione dei dati critici.

• Esperienza con mappatura funzionale e modellazione dei processi aziendali (BPMN o equivalente).

• Capacità comprovata di collaborare tra business, analisi aziendale, architettura delle soluzioni e team IT.

jobs.description:
• Role Summary

• We are seeking an experienced IT Tooling / DevOps Specialist to improve the IT tooling platform that support the organization’s Software Development Life Cycle — SDLC.

• The role sits within a team of 13 people in charge of the administration, maintenance, support, and evolution of more than 15 DevOps and SDLC tools among which Git, Ansible Automation Platform, Azure DevOps, Artifactory,…

• The team is organized around four main streams:

• DevOps onboarding of application and infrastructure teams

• IT tooling platform enhancements / optimization / maintenance

• DevOps governance definition

• User support

• While contributing to platform maintenance and user support activities, the primary focus of this role will be the platform enhancements, optimization, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across the IT tooling landscape.

• Key Responsibilities

• Propose and implement enhancements to existing tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, Ansible Automation Platform, Artifactory,…

• Assess new features, plugins, integrations, and automation opportunities to improve developer experience and operational efficiency

• Define and maintain platform configuration standards, usage guidelines, governance models, and best practices

• Contribute to the onboarding and the support of users

• Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, reliability, scalability, usability, security, and cost efficiency

• Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure tooling platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards and technology strategy

• Contribute to the definition and execution of the IT tooling roadmap.

• Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on DevOps tools experience , especially with Azure DevOps Jira, Ansible Automated Platform and Git

• Strong experience designing and implementing DevOps solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to design solutions where no standard pattern exists

• Technical Skills

• Tools: GIT, Azure DevOps Server, Docker, SonarQube, Artifactory, Ansible Automated Platform, AppDynamics, JIRA, OpenShift, confluence

• Languages: python , PowerShell, ksh, groovy, Ansible Experience in continuous integration and continuous delivery, scripting for tasks automation.

• Soft Skills

• Ability to prioritize competing demands across operations, support, onboarding, and enhancement activities

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across IT, development, security, infrastructure, and business teams

• Ability to translate user needs and operational pain points into actionable platform improvements

• Strong documentation, communication, and presentation skills

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: WM Business Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Mission
 The Business Risk Management team plays a key role within the Wealth Management (First Line of Defence). Business Risk Managers (BRM) are the internal referents within Front Office on the subjects of AML, CDB, Risk Appetite and KYC/KYT, and are responsible of opening client accounts and addressing transactional alerts for lower account risk categories.
 Main responsibilities

• Manage onboarding of client accounts end-to-end.

• Perform formal controls on all risk level client onboardings and review the documentation to ensure that it complies with the local and international regulations (CDB, CRS, FATCA) as well as the Bank’s directives and procedures.

• Perform reviews of onboarding file (AML, KYC, KYT, adverse news screening to mitigate risks) prior to Onboarding (lower risks) or Compliance submission (higher risks) with a strong focus on standard and medium risk relations for material checks.

• Ensure documentary accuracy and completeness of corroborations and evidences in adherence to the Bank’s qualitative risk appetite and standards.

• Ensure that, when applicable, the SLA for onboarding is respected.

• Ensure appropriate documentation of, review and close all normal and medium risk Transactional alerts clarified by the front office in a timely manner.

• Launch Event Driven updates following transactional activity shifts and change in Circumstances in the client life cycle to keep KYC/KYT in line with the client’s activity.

• Escalate any deviations from the Bank’s standards to line management and control functions according to policies in place.

• Upon Management’s request, act as a relay of authority within the WM Markets on certain initiatives.

• Apply the changes required by Compliance Quality Control feedbacks in a continuous improvement manner.

• Digital and manual input in the Bank’s systems relating to account openings.

• Collaborate actively across markets with BRMs and Senior BRMs to balance workloads, protect deadlines, and leverage specific market expertise when required.

• Any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee.

Your Profile

• University degree (Bachelor) or a qualification considered equivalent.

• Private Banking, Central file or WM Compliance or equivalent background with strong understanding of CDB, AML, tax regulations and sanctions matters. Any previous experience with MEA markets is an added value.

• Min 5 years of experience.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the flexibility to seamlessly interact with different levels of seniority and authority.

• Good command of the Bank’s systems and MS Office suite. Knowledge of Power-BI is a plus.

• Fluent in French and English. Any additional language skill is an added value, in particular Arabic.

• Solution oriented team player, capable of working independently.

• Stress resistant, reliable, and flexible.

• Able and willing to learn, acquire new skills and grow in an agile organization.

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Business Risk Managers (BRM) sono i referenti interni all'interno di Front Office sui soggetti di AML, CDB, Risk Appetite e KYC/KYT, e sono responsabili di aprire account client e indirizzare avvisi transazionali per categorie di rischio di account più bassi.
Principali responsabilità

• Gestisci l'invio di account client end-to-end.

• Eseguire controlli formali su tutte le ispezioni client a livello di rischio e rivedere la documentazione per garantire che sia conforme alle normative locali e internazionali (CDB, CRS, FATCA) così come le direttive e le procedure della Banca.

• Eseguire le recensioni di file onboarding (AML, KYC, KYT, screening di notizie avverse per mitigare i rischi) prima di Onboarding (rischi più bassi) o Compliance (rischi più elevati) con una forte attenzione alle relazioni standard e medio rischio per i controlli materiali.

• Assicurare l’accuratezza e la completezza documentale delle corroborazioni e delle prove nell’aderenza all’appetito e agli standard qualitativi del rischio della Banca.

• Assicurarsi che, quando applicabile, la SLA per l'imbarco sia rispettata.

• Assicurare la documentazione appropriata di, rivedere e chiudere tutti i normali e medio rischio avvisi Transactional chiariti dal front office in modo tempestivo.

• Su richiesta della Direzione, agire come relè di autorità all’interno dei mercati WM su determinate iniziative.
