descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission
The Business Risk Management team plays a key role within the Wealth Management (First Line of Defence). Business Risk Managers (BRM) are the internal referents within Front Office on the subjects of AML, CDB, Risk Appetite and KYC/KYT, and are responsible of opening client accounts and addressing transactional alerts for lower account risk categories.
Main responsibilities

• Manage onboarding of client accounts end-to-end.

• Perform formal controls on all risk level client onboardings and review the documentation to ensure that it complies with the local and international regulations (CDB, CRS, FATCA) as well as the Bank’s directives and procedures.

• Perform reviews of onboarding file (AML, KYC, KYT, adverse news screening to mitigate risks) prior to Onboarding (lower risks) or Compliance submission (higher risks) with a strong focus on standard and medium risk relations for material checks.

• Ensure documentary accuracy and completeness of corroborations and evidences in adherence to the Bank’s qualitative risk appetite and standards.

• Ensure that, when applicable, the SLA for onboarding is respected.

• Ensure appropriate documentation of, review and close all normal and medium risk Transactional alerts clarified by the front office in a timely manner.

• Launch Event Driven updates following transactional activity shifts and change in Circumstances in the client life cycle to keep KYC/KYT in line with the client’s activity.

• Escalate any deviations from the Bank’s standards to line management and control functions according to policies in place.

• Upon Management’s request, act as a relay of authority within the WM Markets on certain initiatives.

• Apply the changes required by Compliance Quality Control feedbacks in a continuous improvement manner.

• Digital and manual input in the Bank’s systems relating to account openings.

• Collaborate actively across markets with BRMs and Senior BRMs to balance workloads, protect deadlines, and leverage specific market expertise when required.

• Any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee.

Your Profile

• University degree (Bachelor) or a qualification considered equivalent.

• Private Banking, Central file or WM Compliance or equivalent background with strong understanding of CDB, AML, tax regulations and sanctions matters. Any previous experience with MEA markets is an added value.

• Min 5 years of experience.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the flexibility to seamlessly interact with different levels of seniority and authority.

• Good command of the Bank’s systems and MS Office suite. Knowledge of Power-BI is a plus.

• Fluent in French and English. Any additional language skill is an added value, in particular Arabic.

• Solution oriented team player, capable of working independently.

• Stress resistant, reliable, and flexible.

• Able and willing to learn, acquire new skills and grow in an agile organization.

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission
Das Business Risk Management Team spielt eine Schlüsselrolle im Wealth Management (First Line of Defence). Business Risk Manager (BRM) sind die internen Referenten innerhalb des Front Office zu den Themen AML, CDB, Risk Appetite und KYC/KYT und sind für die Eröffnung von Kundenkonten und die Adressierung von Transaktionsbenachrichtigungen für niedrigere Risikokategorien verantwortlich.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Verwalten Sie das Onboarding von Kundenkonten durchgängig.

• Führen Sie formale Kontrollen aller risikoorientierten Kunden-Onboardings durch und überprüfen Sie die Dokumentation, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den lokalen und internationalen Vorschriften (CDB, CRS, FATCA) sowie den Richtlinien und Verfahren der Bank entspricht.

• Durchführung von Überprüfungen von Onboarding-Dateien (AML, KYC, KYT, Screening negativer Nachrichten zur Risikominderung) vor Onboarding (geringere Risiken) oder Compliance-Einreichung (höhere Risiken) mit einem starken Fokus auf Standard- und Mittelrisikobeziehungen für Materialprüfungen.

• Gewährleistung der Dokumentationsgenauigkeit und Vollständigkeit der Bestätigungen und Nachweise in Übereinstimmung mit der qualitativen Risikobereitschaft und den Standards der Bank.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass gegebenenfalls die SLA für das Onboarding eingehalten wird.

• Gewährleistung einer angemessenen Dokumentation, Überprüfung und Schließung aller normalen und mittleren Risiko-Transaktionswarnungen, die vom Front Office rechtzeitig geklärt werden.

• Starten Sie Event Driven-Updates nach transaktionalen Aktivitätsverschiebungen und Änderungen der Umstände im Clientlebenszyklus, um KYC/KYT in Einklang mit der Aktivität des Kunden zu halten.

• Eskalieren Sie alle Abweichungen von den Standards der Bank zu den Linienmanagement- und Kontrollfunktionen gemäß den geltenden Richtlinien.

• Handeln Sie auf Wunsch des Managements als Autoritätsrelais innerhalb der WM Markets für bestimmte Initiativen.

• Wenden Sie die von Compliance-Qualitätskontroll-Feedbacks geforderten Änderungen in einer kontinuierlichen Verbesserung an.

• Digitale und manuelle Eingabe in die Systeme der Bank in Bezug auf Kontoeröffnungen.

• Marktübergreifend aktiv mit BRMs und Senior BRMs zusammenarbeiten, um Workloads auszugleichen, Termine zu schützen und bei Bedarf spezifische Marktkenntnisse zu nutzen.

• Jede andere Aufgabe, die vom Management in Bezug auf die Mission des Mitarbeiters erforderlich ist.

• Universitätsabschluss (Bachelor) oder eine Qualifikation als gleichwertig angesehen.

• Private Banking, Central File oder WM Compliance oder gleichwertiger Hintergrund mit starkem Verständnis von CDB, AML, Steuervorschriften und Sanktionen. Jede vorherige Erfahrung mit MEA-Märkten ist ein Mehrwert.

• Min 5 Jahre Erfahrung.

• Starke zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit der Flexibilität, nahtlos mit verschiedenen Ebenen von Dienstalter und Autorität zu interagieren.

• Gute Beherrschung der Systeme der Bank und MS Office Suite. Wissen über Power-BI ist ein Plus.

• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch. Jede zusätzliche Sprachkompetenz ist ein Mehrwert, insbesondere Arabisch.

• Lösungsorientierter Teamplayer, der unabhängig arbeiten kann.

• Stressresistent, zuverlässig und flexibel.

• Fähig und bereit zu lernen, neue Fähigkeiten zu erwerben und in einer agilen Organisation zu wachsen.

Andere

• Gérer l'embarquement des comptes clients de bout en bout.

• Effectuer des contrôles officiels sur tous les niveaux de risque des clients à bord et examiner la documentation pour s'assurer qu'elle est conforme aux règlements locaux et internationaux (CDB, CRS, FATCA) ainsi qu'aux directives et procédures de la Banque.

• Effectuer des examens des dossiers d'embarquement (AML, KYC, KYT, dépistage des nouvelles indésirables afin d'atténuer les risques) avant d'aller à bord (risques moindres) ou de soumettre une demande de conformité (risques plus élevés) en mettant fortement l'accent sur les relations de risque normalisées et moyennes pour les vérifications matérielles.

• Assurer l'exactitude documentaire et l'exhaustivité des corroborations et des preuves en conformité avec les normes et l'appétit qualitatifs de risque de la Banque.

• S'assurer que, le cas échéant, l'ALS pour l'embarquement est respecté.

• Assurer la documentation appropriée, examiner et fermer toutes les alertes transactionnelles à risque normal et moyen clarifiées par le bureau principal en temps opportun.

• Lancer Event Driven mises à jour suite aux changements d'activité transactionnelle et de changement dans les circonstances du cycle de vie du client pour maintenir KYC/KYT en ligne avec l'activité du client.

• Élargir les écarts par rapport aux normes de la Banque aux fonctions de gestion et de contrôle des lignes conformément aux politiques en place.

• Sur demande de la direction, agir comme relais d'autorité au sein des Marchés de WM sur certaines initiatives.

• Appliquer les changements requis par les rétroactions du contrôle de la qualité de la conformité de façon continue.

• Entrées numériques et manuelles dans les systèmes de la Banque concernant les ouvertures de comptes.

• Collaborer activement à l'échelle des marchés avec les GRM et les GRM supérieurs afin d'équilibrer la charge de travail, de protéger les échéances et de tirer parti de l'expertise du marché au besoin.

• Private Banking, Central file ou WM Conformité ou expérience équivalente avec une bonne compréhension des questions de CDB, de LAM, de réglementation fiscale et de sanctions. Toute expérience antérieure sur les marchés des AEM est une valeur ajoutée.

• Moins 5 ans d'expérience.

• Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication avec la souplesse nécessaire pour interagir de façon transparente avec différents niveaux d'ancienneté et d'autorité.

• Bonne maîtrise des systèmes de la Banque et de la suite MS Office. La connaissance du pouvoir-BI est un plus.

• Fluent en français et en anglais. Toute compétence linguistique supplémentaire est une valeur ajoutée, en particulier l'arabe.

• Joueur d'équipe orienté solution, capable de travailler indépendamment.

• Résistant au stress, fiable et flexible.

• Capable et disposé à apprendre, à acquérir de nouvelles compétences et à grandir dans une organisation agile.

Autres

jobs.description:
• Main responsibilities

• Strategy & Planning:
• Define and implement risk-based test strategies aligned with scope, timelines, and regulatory constraints.

• Maintain test plans covering functional, system integration, non-functional, and regression testing.

• Test Execution (Manual & Automated):
• Execute end-to-end scenarios across private banking processes (onboarding/KYC, client data, payments, treasury/trading workflows, portfolio and regulatory reporting).

• Validate back-end behaviour with SQL queries, API checks, and log analysis. (where applicable)

• Quality Governance & Reporting:
• Enforce QA standards, traceability, and documentation throughout the SDLC.

• Use JIRA and Xray for requirements coverage, test design/execution, defect lifecycle, and reporting.

• Provide clear status updates and KPIs to QA Lead, Release Management, and Project Management.

• Defect & Risk Management:
• Log, prioritize, and track defects; lead or participate in defect triage with Development, Product, and Operations.

• Contribute to release entry/exit criteria and go/no-go recommendations.

• UAT & Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Co-define UAT strategy with business stakeholders, document acceptance criteria.

• Support UAT execution, triage, and sign-off readiness.

• Continuous Improvement:
• Drive improvements in test design, data management, automation reliability, and reporting; contribute to playbooks and reusable assets.

• Required Technical Proficiency

• Test Operations:
• Strong experience executing manual and automated tests.

• Hands-on with JIRA and Xray for test case management, traceability, and reporting.

• Perform exploratory data analysis on test results and datasets to detect quality issues, define use cases, quantify impact, and prioritize tests.

• Automation Execution (No Coding Required):

• Comfortable operating existing automation packs:
• Use IDEs such as IntelliJ to configure/run suites, view console output, and interpret stack traces.

• Execute tests locally and via CI tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI); manage variables, environments, and test data.

• Basic Git literacy for fetching branches/tags and triggering relevant suites.

• Your Profile

• Financial Services:
• 5+ years in banking, ideally Private Banking/Wealth Management; familiarity with payments, trading and treasury flows, client lifecycle (KYC/AML), and regulatory/portfolio reporting.

• Technical:
• Proficient in SQL for data validation and reconciliation across systems.

• Exposure to automation tools (e.g., Selenium) and familiarity with Java/Python for reading test code and interpreting failures.

• Process:
• Solid experience defining UAT strategies, test data management, and environment orchestration.

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented, risk-aware mindset.

• Clear, concise communicator able to synthesize complex findings for non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborative and proactive; comfortable facilitating cross-team triage and decision-making.

• Adaptable with a continuous learning mindset and ownership of quality outcomes.

Languages

• Proficiency in French and English required; German is a plus.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Principali responsabilità

• Strategia e pianificazione:
• Definire e implementare strategie di test basate sui rischi allineate a limiti di portata, tempestività e regolazione.

• Mantenere i piani di prova che coprono l'integrazione funzionale, sistema, test non funzionali e regressioni.

• Esecuzione test (Manuale e Automatizzato):
• Eseguire scenari end-to-end attraverso processi bancari privati (onboarding/KYC, dati client, pagamenti, flussi di lavoro di tesoreria/trading, portafoglio e reporting normativo).

• Convalida il comportamento back-end con query SQL, controlli API e analisi dei log. (ove applicabile)

• Qualità Governance & Reporting:
• Applicare gli standard QA, la tracciabilità e la documentazione in tutto il SDLC.

• Utilizzare JIRA e Xray per la copertura dei requisiti, la progettazione/esecuzione del test, il ciclo di vita del difetto e la segnalazione.

• Fornisci aggiornamenti di stato chiari e KPI a QA Lead, Gestione dei comunicati e Project Management.

• Gestione dei difetti e dei rischi:
• Log, priorità e tracciare i difetti; condurre o partecipare a difetti triage con sviluppo, prodotto e operazioni.

• Contribuire a rilasciare i criteri di entrata / uscita e andare/no-go raccomandazioni.

• UAT & Stakeholder Collaborazione:
• Codefinire la strategia UAT con gli stakeholder aziendali, i criteri di accettazione dei documenti.

• Supporto Esecuzione UAT, triage e prontezza di firma.

• Miglioramento continuo:
• Miglioramento dell'azionamento nella progettazione di test, nella gestione dei dati, nell'affidabilità dell'automazione e nella segnalazione; contributo ai playbook e alle attività riutilizzabili.

• Competenza tecnica richiesta

• Operazioni di prova:
• Forte esperienza nell'esecuzione di test manuali e automatizzati.

• Hands-on con JIRA e Xray per la gestione dei casi di prova, tracciabilità e reporting.

• Eseguire l'analisi dei dati esplorativi sui risultati dei test e sui set di dati per rilevare i problemi di qualità, definire i casi di utilizzo, quantificare l'impatto e dare priorità ai test.

• Esecuzione dell'automazione (nessuna codifica richiesta):

• Comodi pacchetti di automazione operativi esistenti:
• Utilizzare IDE come IntelliJ per configurare / eseguire suite, visualizzare l'output della console e interpretare le tracce di stack.

• Eseguire test localmente e tramite strumenti CI (ad esempio Azure DevOps, GitLab CI); gestire variabili, ambienti e dati di test.

• Base di base Git literacy per la cattura di rami / tag e innescare suite pertinenti.

• Il tuo profilo

• Servizi finanziari:
• 5+ anni nel settore bancario, idealmente Private Banking/Wealth Management; familiarità con i pagamenti, trading e flussi di tesoreria, ciclo di vita del cliente (KYC/AML), e la regolazione / report del portafoglio.

• Tecnica:
• Proficiente in SQL per la convalida dei dati e la riconciliazione tra i sistemi.

• Esposizione agli strumenti di automazione (ad esempio, Selenium) e familiarità con Java/Python per la lettura del codice di prova e l'interpretazione dei guasti.

• Processo:
• Esperienza solida che definisce le strategie UAT, la gestione dei dati di prova e l'orchestrazione dell'ambiente.

Abilità morbide

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con una mentalità orientata al dettaglio, con attenzione al rischio.

• comunicatore chiaro e conciso in grado di sintetizzare i risultati complessi per gli stakeholder non tecnici.

• Collaborativo e proattivo; confortevole facilitando triage cross-team e processo decisionale.

• Adattabile con una mentalità di apprendimento continuo e la proprietà dei risultati di qualità.

Lingue

• La competenza in francese e inglese richiesto; il tedesco è un plus.

Istruzione

• Corso di laurea in informatica, sistemi informativi, o relativo campo (o esperienza equivalente).

• Altri
• Residenza svizzera

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• Gouvernance de la qualité et rapports :
• Appliquer les normes d'AQ, la traçabilité et la documentation dans l'ensemble du SDLC.

• Utilisez JIRA et Xray pour la couverture des exigences, la conception/exécution des essais, le cycle de vie des défauts et la déclaration.

• Fournir des mises à jour claires et des ICR au responsable de l'AQ, à la gestion des rejets et à la gestion de projet.

• Gestion des défauts et des risques :
• Enregistrez, priorisez et tracez les défauts; dirigez ou participez au triage des défauts avec Développement, Produit et Opérations.

• Contribuer à la publication des critères d'entrée et de sortie et des recommandations d'aller et de ne pas aller.

• Collaboration entre les TAU et les intervenants :
• Co-définir la stratégie de TAU avec les intervenants commerciaux, les critères d'acceptation des documents.

• Appuyer l'exécution, le triage et l'approbation de l'UTA.

• Amélioration continue :
• Favoriser l'amélioration de la conception des tests, de la gestion des données, de la fiabilité de l'automatisation et des rapports; contribuer aux livres de lecture et aux actifs réutilisables.

• Compétence technique requise

• Opérations d'essai:
• Forte expérience dans l'exécution de tests manuels et automatisés.

• Mise à jour pratique avec JIRA et Xray pour la gestion des cas d'essai, la traçabilité et les rapports.

• Effectuer une analyse des données exploratoires sur les résultats des essais et les ensembles de données pour détecter les problèmes de qualité, définir les cas d'utilisation, quantifier l'impact et prioriser les essais.

• Exécution automatique (pas de codage requis):

• Kits d'automatisation existants pour un fonctionnement confortable:
• Utilisez des IDE comme IntelliJ pour configurer/exécuter les suites, afficher la sortie de console et interpréter les traces de pile.

• Exécuter des tests locaux et via des outils CI (p. ex. Azure DevOps, GitLab CI); gérer les variables, les environnements et les données de test.

• Niveau de base Littératie git pour récupérer les branches/tags et déclencher les suites pertinentes.

• Votre profil

• Services financiers :
• 5 ans et plus en banque, idéalement Private Banking/Wealth Management; connaissance des paiements, du trading et des flux de trésorerie, du cycle de vie des clients (KYC/AML) et des rapports réglementaires/portfolio.

• Technique:
• Compétence en SQL pour la validation des données et le rapprochement entre les systèmes.

• Exposition aux outils d'automatisation (p. ex., Sélénium) et familiarisation avec Java/Python pour la lecture du code de test et l'interprétation des échecs.

• Processus :
• Expérience solide définissant les stratégies de TAU, la gestion des données de test et l'orchestration environnementale.

Compétences souples

• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit axé sur le détail et conscient du risque.

• Communication claire et concise capable de synthétiser des constatations complexes pour les intervenants non techniques.

• Collaborative et proactive; pratique de faciliter le triage et la prise de décisions entre équipes.

• Adaptable avec un état d'esprit d'apprentissage continu et la maîtrise des résultats de qualité.

Langues

Éducation

jobs.title: Fees specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Integrated within UBP’s Operations department, the Fees team manages the day to day application and collection of fees from clients’ accounts and market counterparties group wise. The team has an interdisciplinary role in a fast-paced environment : it supports the Front Office for fees queries and works in close collaboration with the other departments of the Asset and Wealth management divisions of UBP.

• Main responsibilities

Its main missions are as follows:

• Create, amend and maintain the base fees schedules group wise.

• Set-up, amend and manage the clients’ fees exceptions.

• Set-up, amend and manage the brokers and other internal counterparties fees exceptions.

• Perform appropriate follow-up on outstanding fee setups or requests.

• Daily support to internal clients, including but not limited to Front Office, WM Business leads, Finance and other teams within the Operations department.

• Prepare and manage the quarterly fees billing, follow-up on quarterly billing tasks, including manual billing exceptions.

• Actively take part in the bank’s repricing initiatives, support WM leads on fees opportunities.

• Actively take part in other projects impacting the Fees team.

• Core competencies

The successful candidate will possess the following skills:

• Analytical and problem solving skills: be at ease with numbers and larger datasets. Be able to think in “problem-action-results” terms.

• Flexibility: Be proactive and driven. Be able to adjust to urgent requests or shifting priorities, maange time effectively. Adjust decision-making in light of unforeseen circumstances.

• Client service ethic: Professional conduct with strong focus on client service, build lasting relationships with other departments of the group.

• Risk management : Review existing control framework to identify procedural loopholes or enhancement opportunities. Be able to raise concerns and propose mitigations or enhancement solutions. Be able to support audit requests, in coordination with the team’s supervisor or manager.

• Team spirit : Proactively help others and work for a common goal. Be open to others’ ideas, express opinion in a constructive way.

• Your Profile

• French and English speaking mandatory. Other languages is a plus.

• Preferrably knowledgeable in market finance : understands the various financial instruments, the trading and reconciliation flows as well as the custody chain.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office pack, specifically Microsoft Excel. Other VBA/Python/R skills is a plus.

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione
Integrato all'interno del dipartimento Operazioni UBP, il team di Fees gestisce l'applicazione giorno per giorno e la raccolta di tasse da account clienti e controparti di mercato gruppo saggi. Il team ha un ruolo interdisciplinare in un ambiente frenetico: supporta il Front Office per le richieste di tasse e lavora in stretta collaborazione con gli altri dipartimenti delle divisioni di gestione Asset e Wealth di UBP.

• Principali responsabilità

Integrato all'interno del dipartimento Operazioni UBP, il team di Fees gestisce l'applicazione giorno per giorno e la raccolta di tasse da account clienti e controparti di mercato gruppo saggi. Il team ha un ruolo interdisciplinare in un ambiente frenetico: supporta il Front Office per le richieste di tasse e lavora in stretta collaborazione con gli altri dipartimenti delle divisioni di gestione Asset e Wealth di UBP.

Le sue principali missioni sono le seguenti:

• Creare, modificare e mantenere le spese di base programma gruppo saggio.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire le tasse dei clienti eccezioni.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire i broker e altre controparti interne tasse eccezioni.

• Eseguire il follow-up appropriato su impostazioni o richieste di pagamento eccezionali.

• Supporto giornaliero a clienti interni, inclusi ma non limitati a Front Office, WM Business, Finanza e altre squadre all'interno del reparto Operazioni.

• Preparare e gestire le commissioni trimestrali fatturazione, follow-up sulle attività di fatturazione trimestrale, comprese le eccezioni di fatturazione manuale.

• Partecipa attivamente alle iniziative di riformulazione della banca, supporto WM conduce alle opportunità di commissioni.

• Partecipa attivamente ad altri progetti che influenzano il team Fees.

• Competenze fondamentali

Il candidato di successo possederà le seguenti competenze:

• Analitica e problem solving competenze: essere a proprio agio con numeri e dataset più grandi. Essere in grado di pensare in termini “problem-action-results”.

• Flessibilità: Sii proattivo e guidato. Essere in grado di adattarsi alle richieste urgenti o alle priorità di spostamento, maange il tempo in modo efficace. Regolare il processo decisionale alla luce di circostanze impreviste.

• Servizio clienti etico: condotta professionale con forte attenzione al servizio clienti, costruire relazioni durature con altri dipartimenti del gruppo.

• Gestione del rischio: rivedere il quadro di controllo esistente per identificare scappatoie procedurali o opportunità di miglioramento. Essere in grado di sollevare preoccupazioni e proporre mitigazioni o soluzioni di miglioramento. Essere in grado di sostenere le richieste di audit, in coordinamento con il supervisore del team o manager.

• Spirito di squadra: Proattivamente aiutare gli altri e lavorare per un obiettivo comune. Sii aperto alle idee altrui, esprimere l’opinione in modo costruttivo.

• Il tuo profilo

• Francese e inglese che parlano obbligatorio. Altre lingue sono un plus.

• Preferibilmente conoscibile nella finanza di mercato: comprende i vari strumenti finanziari, i flussi di negoziazione e riconciliazione e la catena di custodia.

• Proficiente con Microsoft Office pack, in particolare Microsoft Excel. Altre abilità VBA/Python/R sono un plus.

• Altri
• Residenza svizzera

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• Mission
Integriert in die Operations-Abteilung von UBP verwaltet das Gebühren-Team die tägliche Anwendung und Erhebung von Gebühren von Kundenkonten und Gegenparteien. Das Team spielt in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld eine interdisziplinäre Rolle: Es unterstützt das Front Office bei Gebührenabfragen und arbeitet eng mit den anderen Abteilungen der Asset- und Wealth-Management-Divisionen der UBP zusammen.

• Hauptzuständigkeiten

Integriert in die Operations-Abteilung von UBP verwaltet das Gebühren-Team die tägliche Anwendung und Erhebung von Gebühren von Kundenkonten und Gegenparteien. Das Team spielt in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld eine interdisziplinäre Rolle: Es unterstützt das Front Office bei Gebührenabfragen und arbeitet eng mit den anderen Abteilungen der Asset- und Wealth-Management-Divisionen der UBP zusammen.

Seine Hauptaufgaben sind wie folgt:

• Erstellen, ändern und pflegen Sie die Basisgebührenpläne gruppenweise.

• Einrichtung, Änderung und Verwaltung der Gebührenausnahmen der Kunden.

• Einrichten, Ändern und Verwalten von Ausnahmen von den Gebühren für Broker und andere interne Gegenparteien.

• Führen Sie angemessene Folgemaßnahmen zu ausstehenden Gebühreneinstellungen oder Anfragen durch.

• Tägliche Unterstützung für interne Kunden, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Front Office, WM Business Leads, Finanzen und andere Teams innerhalb der Operations-Abteilung.

• Bereiten und verwalten Sie die vierteljährliche Gebührenabrechnung, Follow-up für vierteljährliche Abrechnungsaufgaben, einschließlich manueller Abrechnungsausnahmen.

• Nehmen Sie aktiv an den Repricing-Initiativen der Bank teil und unterstützen Sie WM-Leads bei Gebührenmöglichkeiten.

• Nehmen Sie aktiv an anderen Projekten teil, die sich auf das Gebührenteam auswirken.

• Kernkompetenzen

Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird die folgenden Fähigkeiten besitzen:

• Analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten: Seien Sie mit Zahlen und größeren Datensätzen vertraut. Seien Sie in der Lage, in "Problem-Action-Ergebnissen" zu denken.

• Flexibilität: Seien Sie proaktiv und motiviert. In der Lage sein, sich an dringende Anfragen oder wechselnde Prioritäten anzupassen, die Zeit effektiv zu verändern. Anpassung der Entscheidungsfindung an unvorhergesehene Umstände.

• Kundendienstethik: Professionelles Verhalten mit starkem Fokus auf Kundenservice, Aufbau dauerhafter Beziehungen zu anderen Abteilungen der Gruppe.

• Risikomanagement: Überprüfung des bestehenden Kontrollrahmens, um Verfahrenslücken oder Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren. In der Lage sein, Bedenken zu äußern und Minderungs- oder Verbesserungslösungen vorzuschlagen. In der Lage sein, Auditanfragen in Abstimmung mit dem Vorgesetzten oder Manager des Teams zu unterstützen.

• Teamgeist: Anderen proaktiv helfen und für ein gemeinsames Ziel arbeiten. Seien Sie offen für die Ideen anderer, äußern Sie Ihre Meinung konstruktiv.

• Ihr Profil

• Französisch und Englisch sprechen obligatorisch. Andere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Vorzugsweise kenntnisreich in der Marktfinanzierung: versteht die verschiedenen Finanzinstrumente, die Handels- und Abstimmungsströme sowie die Depotkette.

• Proficient mit Microsoft Office Pack, speziell Microsoft Excel. Andere VBA / Python / R-Fähigkeiten sind ein Plus.

• Andere
• Schweizer Residenz

Kernkompetenzen : Einhaltung der Werte des Unternehmens: Hingabe, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien

jobs.title: Tax Specialist (Temporary 8 months)
jobs.description:
Mission
 We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department. As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers. This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank.

Main responsibilities

• Tax Statement Review & Validation
• Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others.

• Ensure that tax statements are consistent with the country-specific tax rules.

• Data Quality Assurance
• Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production.

• Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting.

• Client Support & Front Office Interaction
• Address inquiries and requests from the Front Office regarding tax statements, providing clear and precise explanations.

• Manage tax document orders in coordination with internal teams and external providers.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Operations, Front Office, and IT teams to ensure smooth management of tax processes.

• Actively participate in cross-functional projects involving process improvements or strategic initiatives.

• Project Management
• Contribute to side projects related to tax data, information systems, and operational processes.

• Participate in the continuous improvement of tools and processes in collaboration with IT and other departments.

• Reporting
• Stay updated on tax regulatory changes across the covered jurisdictions.

• Maintain up-to-date tax statement checklists, process/procedure documents, and any other team-relevant documentation.

Your Profile

• Experience: Minimum 4 years in banking or tax environment with a focus on tax services.

• Skills: Strong knowledge of financial instruments (Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Derivatives – listed or OTC) and their specific characteristics. Familiarity with European income and gains taxation is a plus. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential.

• Mindset: Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn. Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work quickly and efficiently, and a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

• Detail-oriented and logic-driven, able to quickly detect discrepancies in tax statements.

• Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex data and identify anomalies in database.

• Client Orientation: Excellent communication skills to address Front Office and client inquiries.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with multidisciplinary teams (IT, Operations, etc.).

• Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

• Languages: Fluency in French and English is required; German, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese is a plus.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione
Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista fiscale motivato e orientato al dettaglio per aderire al nostro Servizio Clienti Documentazione e Servizi fiscali. Nell’ambito del team Fiscal Reporting, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire l’accuratezza e la qualità delle dichiarazioni fiscali dei nostri clienti, collaborando con vari dipartimenti e fornitori esterni. Si tratta di un'occasione unica per crescere in un ambiente veloce e stimolante e contribuire a progetti di impatto in tutta la banca.

Principali responsabilità

• Valutazione e convalida delle dichiarazioni fiscali
• Verificare e convalidare le dichiarazioni fiscali per oltre 20 giurisdizioni internazionali, tra cui Svizzera, Francia, Portogallo, Messico e altri.

• Assicurarsi che le dichiarazioni fiscali siano conformi alle norme fiscali specifiche del paese.

• Assicurazione sulla qualità dei dati
• Collabora con il nostro fornitore esterno per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza dei dati fiscali prima della produzione di dichiarazioni.

• Identificare e correggere anomalie o incongruenze nei dati per garantire un report affidabile.

• Supporto clienti e Interazione dell'ufficio anteriore
• Rivolgersi alle richieste e alle richieste del Front Office relative alle dichiarazioni fiscali, fornendo spiegazioni chiare e precise.

• Gestire gli ordini dei documenti fiscali in coordinamento con le squadre interne e i fornitori esterni.

• Collaborazione trasversale
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Operations, Front Office e IT per garantire una gestione regolare dei processi fiscali.

• Partecipa attivamente a progetti interfunzionali che coinvolgono miglioramenti di processo o iniziative strategiche.

• Gestione dei progetti
• Contribuire a progetti collaterali relativi ai dati fiscali, sistemi informativi e processi operativi.

• Partecipa al continuo miglioramento di strumenti e processi in collaborazione con IT e altri reparti.

• Relazione
• Resta aggiornato sulle modifiche fiscali nelle giurisdizioni coperte.

• Mantenere liste di controllo delle dichiarazioni fiscali aggiornate, documenti di processo/procedura, e qualsiasi altra documentazione di squadra-rilevante.

Il tuo profilo

• Esperienza: minimo 4 anni in ambiente bancario o fiscale con un focus sui servizi fiscali.

• Competenze: Forte conoscenza degli strumenti finanziari (Equità, Obbligazioni, Prodotti Strutturati, Derivati – elencati o OTC) e le loro caratteristiche specifiche. La familiarità con il reddito europeo e i guadagni fiscali è un plus. La competenza in Microsoft Office è essenziale.

• Mindset: Proattivo, orientato alla soluzione, e desideroso di imparare. Forte capacità di problem solving, capacità di lavorare in modo rapido ed efficiente, e un giocatore di squadra che prospera in un ambiente frenetico.

• Dettaglio e logica-driven, in grado di rilevare rapidamente discrepanze nelle dichiarazioni fiscali.

• Competenze analitiche: Capacità di analizzare dati complessi e identificare anomalie nel database.

• Orientamento del cliente: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione per affrontare le richieste del front office e del cliente.

• Collaborazione trasversale: esperienza di lavoro con team multidisciplinari (IT, operazioni, ecc.).

• Project Management: Capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente e rispettare le scadenze.

• Lingue: È richiesta la fluidità in francese e inglese; tedesco, italiano, spagnolo o portoghese è un plus.

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Operations, Front Office und IT-Teams zusammen, um eine reibungslose Verwaltung der Steuerprozesse zu gewährleisten.

• Beitrag zu Nebenprojekten im Zusammenhang mit Steuerdaten, Informationssystemen und operativen Prozessen.

• SECURITIES TRANSFERS OFFICER - 6 MONTHS MISSION

• Mission

• Ensure the clients' assets delivery/receipt for all the activities associated with the transfer of securities to a different financial establishment or within the Bank.

jobs.description:
• Mission
 At UBP, you will join the CLM (Client Lifecycle Management) team to operate, stabilize, and enhance Appway workflows (onboarding, KYC reviews, remediations). The role is primarily focused on Level 2/Level 3 support and run activities (80%), with a development/engineering component (20%) for fixes, minor enhancements, and industrialization.
 The mission is to ensure the availability, performance, and compliance of Appway CLM solutions while delivering targeted improvements and securing multi-environment deployments.

• Main responsibilities

Support & Run (80%)

• Provide L2/L3 application support: triage, diagnosis, incident/problem resolution, and coordination with the vendor/integrators.

• Monitor workflow health: SLAs, queues, jobs, logs; set up and maintain dashboards and alerts.

• Conduct root cause analyses (RCA) and define/implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Manage releases and package promotion (CAB, validations, smoke tests, rollback plans).

• Document operating procedures, runbooks, a Known Error Database, and user guides.

• Participate in on-call/extended hours as scheduled; ensure incident communications (IT/Business) and reporting.

• Optimize stability and performance: housekeeping, capacity management, tuning, error handling, and resilience.

• Ensure operational compliance (traceability, auditability, data protection, banking secrecy).

• Able to evaluate risks in Private Market Transactions

• Engagement with managers

jobs.description:
• Mission
 We are seeking a skilled and experienced Database Engineer to join our team in Geneva and modernize the bank’s data layer on Sybase ASE and Sybase IQ. The ideal candidate will manage and optimize complex stored procedures, re-engineer UNIX ksh and SQL scripts using modern patterns, and ensure reliable ETL pipelines for operational and transactional banking data.

• Main responsibilities

• Review existing data systems and architectures to identify improvement and optimization

• Design, develop, and maintain complex stored procedures, functions, and packages on Sybase ASE Sybase IQ

• Optimize database performance: indexing, statistics, partitioning, query plans, parallelism, compression.

• Analyze existing UNIX ksh and SQL scripts; simplify and rewrite with modern structures, parameterization, error-handling, and logging.

• Develop & manage on-premises applications build on MS .Net & Angular Framework.

• Build and support ETL/ELT workflows: data ingestion, validation, transformations, reconciliation, and scheduling (e.g., Control M).

• Ensure data quality and reliability for daily/weekly/monthly cycles; implement monitoring, and alerts.

• Collaborate with Finance/Operations teams to translate requirements into robust database and batch solutions.

• Troubleshoot production incidents; perform root-cause analysis and preventative fixes while meeting the SLAs.

Technical skills

• Sybase ASE and Sybase IQ (8+ years hands-on)
• Advanced SQL, stored procedures, performance tuning, query plan analysis.

• Data modeling for large analytical/operational workloads.

• UNIX/Linux
• Strong ksh/bash scripting, file handling, scheduling, permissions etc.

• Banking data
• Solid understanding of operational/transactional and financial datasets and KPIs (balances, movements, fees, commissions, net interest margin)

• .NET Framework/C# exposure, experience applying GitHub Copilot for refactoring, app modernization.

• Agile delivery with JIRA/Confluence and GitHub
 Your Profile

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proactive in improving reliability, performance, and maintainability

• Ownership mindset with positive attitude -and Team player

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills - comfortable with business and IT stakeholders.

Languages

• English: Fluent

• French: Fluent

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Project Manager (Consultant)
jobs.description:
Mission

• Within the COO IT Change unit, the role is responsible for coordinating execution and performing business analysis across a portfolio of IT projects and small demands in the Asia Core Banking domain. Focus areas include digital transformation (ebanking, CRM) and regulatory initiatives (Payments, Regulatory reporting).

Challenges

• Manage a diverse array of projects with multiple stakeholders.

• Daily interactions and coordination with an external software/vendor partner responsible for delivery.

Main Responsibilities

• Partner with business and IT stakeholders, including an external vendor, across a wide and diverse project agenda.

• Ensure stakeholder and sponsor involvement and commitment.

• Define clear scope and requirements; manage scope changes.

• Identify and manage project risks and conflicts.

• Oversee budgeting processes and control project spend.

• Plan and manage IT resources.

• Implement technical solutions in line with the bank’s software development lifecycle, in partnership with the main software vendor in charge of the delivery.

• Coordinate and participate in testing; obtain customer sign-off.

• Publish project reporting; build and maintain KPIs and KRIs.

• Collect and formalize lessons learned among stakeholders; ensure their application to future projects.

Requested Skills & Experience

• Overall knowledge of Private Banking processes and IT banking architecture - Familiarity with Asia is a plus (e.g., regulatory environment).

• Experience in the Financial sector (mandatory); experience in Private Banking (mandatory).

• Strong vendor management capabilities.

• Ability to bridge the gap between business and technical teams.

• Comfortable with both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.

• Planning and budget control.

Education : Engineer (or equivalent technical education).
 Experience : At least 10 years (senior level).
 Languages : English: Fluent.

Personal Skills & Attributes

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proactive, Drive, leadership, and positive attitude; stress resistant.

• Team player, resourceful, and independent.

Swiss Residence : Optional.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Sfide

• Gestisci una vasta gamma di progetti con più stakeholder.

• Interazioni giornaliere e coordinamento con un partner software/vendor esterno responsabile della consegna.

Principali responsabilità

• Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT, tra cui un fornitore esterno, attraverso un ampio e diversificato programma di progetto.

• Assicurare il coinvolgimento e l'impegno degli stakeholder e degli sponsor.

• Definire la portata e i requisiti chiari; gestire i cambiamenti di portata.

• Identificare e gestire i rischi e i conflitti di progetto.

• Superare i processi di bilancio e la spesa del progetto di controllo.

• Pianificare e gestire le risorse IT.

• Implementare soluzioni tecniche in linea con il ciclo di vita di sviluppo software della banca, in collaborazione con il principale fornitore di software responsabile della consegna.

• Coordinare e partecipare a test; ottenere il cliente sign-off.

• Pubblica reportistica del progetto; costruisci e mantieni KPI e KRI.

• Raccogliere e formalizzare le lezioni apprese tra le parti interessate; garantire la loro applicazione ai progetti futuri.

Esperienze e competenze richieste

• Conoscenza complessiva dei processi Private Banking e dell'architettura IT banking - La familiarità con l'Asia è un plus (ad esempio, ambiente normativo).

• Esperienza nel settore finanziario (obbligatorio); esperienza in Private Banking (obbligatorio).

• Forte capacità di gestione dei fornitori.

• Capacità di colmare il divario tra business e team tecnici.

• Confortevole con entrambe le metodologie Cascata e Agile.

• Pianificazione e controllo del bilancio.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Proattivo, Drive, leadership e atteggiamento positivo; resistente allo stress.

• Giocatore di squadra, pieno di risorse e indipendente.

Residenza svizzera: opzionale.

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.title: Media Relations & Content Specialist
jobs.description:
• Main Responsibilities
• Media Relations
• Support the Head of Media in implementing the Bank’s media strategy across Europe and the Middle East, with a particular focus on French-speaking Switzerland and key satellite markets.

• Coordinate with media agencies across EMEA to align priorities, timelines and deliverables

• Collaborate with Investment Services, regional teams and other subject-matter experts to source spokespeople and content, and coordinate the full approval process.

• Ensure timely, accurate and on-brand responses to journalists and media partners.

• Proactively coordinate interviews, briefings and market commentary with the relevant internal experts.

• Prepare and update key media materials (Q&As, talking points, short bios, background notes) as needed.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists in core financial and business media.

• Content Management & Copywriting
• Contribute to the production of high-quality content that supports the Bank’s positioning in investment strategy and asset management.

• Draft and edit press releases, statements, Q&As and opinion pieces in close collaboration with experts.

• Translate complex investment and market topics into clear, concise and compliant messages.

• Review and challenge the quality of content before it is offered to the media.

• Ensure consistency of tone of voice and alignment with the Bank’s brand and communication guidelines.

• Work in close partnership with the Digital team to amplify media coverage and align content.

• Coordinate with Internal Communications to share key media exposure internally.

• Monitoring & Reporting
• Monitor media coverage of the Bank, its experts and its key themes across EMEA.

• Use media monitoring and analytics tools to track visibility and sentiment.

• Prepare regular reports on media KPIs for the Head of Media and relevant stakeholders

• Your Profile
• Experience and Skills Required
• At least 5 years’ experience in media relations within financial services (banking, asset or wealth management) or in an agency with financial clients.

• Proven track record of working with financial and business media in an international environment.

• Strong understanding of the financial services landscape and media ecosystem.

• Excellent writing and editing skills; strong copywriting abilities under time pressure.

• Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines across regions in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience handling sensitive topics in a regulated context.

• Relationship builder, credible with journalists and confident with senior internal experts.

• Team player with a collaborative mindset and a hands-on, operational approach.

• Tools
• Experience with media monitoring and analytics platforms.

• Comfortable with basic data analysis and reporting for KPIs.

• Languages
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).

• French speaker mandatory; other European languages are an advantage.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Contribuire alla produzione di contenuti di alta qualità che supporta il posizionamento della Banca nella strategia di investimento e nella gestione degli asset.

• Progetti e modifiche comunicati stampa, dichiarazioni, Q&As e opinioni in stretta collaborazione con esperti.

• Tradurre complessi argomenti di investimento e di mercato in messaggi chiari, concisi e conformi.

• Recensione e sfida la qualità del contenuto prima che venga offerto ai media.

• Assicurare la coerenza del tono di voce e allineamento con le linee guida del marchio e della comunicazione della Banca.

• Lavora in stretta collaborazione con il team digitale per amplificare la copertura mediatica e allineare i contenuti.

• Coordinate con le comunicazioni interne per condividere l'esposizione dei media chiave internamente.

• Monitorare la copertura mediatica della Banca, i suoi esperti e i suoi temi chiave in EMEA.

• Preparare rapporti regolari sui KPI dei media per il responsabile dei media e le parti interessate rilevanti

• Esperienza e competenze necessarie
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nelle relazioni mediatiche all’interno dei servizi finanziari (banking, asset o gestione patrimoniale) o in un’agenzia con clienti finanziari.

• Provato record di lavoro con i media finanziari e commerciali in un ambiente internazionale.

• Forte comprensione del paesaggio dei servizi finanziari e dell'ecosistema dei media.

• Eccellente capacità di scrittura e editing; forti capacità di copywriting sotto pressione del tempo.

• Capacità di gestire più richieste e scadenze nelle regioni in un ambiente frenetico.

• Prova a gestire argomenti sensibili in un contesto regolamentato.

• Collaboratore, credibile con giornalisti e fiducioso con esperti interni senior.

• Giocatore di squadra con una mentalità collaborativa e un approccio pratico e operativo.

• Strumenti
• Esperienza con le piattaforme di monitoraggio e analisi dei media.

• Confortevole con l'analisi dei dati di base e la segnalazione per i KPI.

• Lingue
• Ottimo comando dell'inglese (scritto e parlato).

• L'oratore francese è obbligatorio; altre lingue europee sono un vantaggio.

jobs.description:
• TEMPORARY MISSION ( 6 MONTHS)

• Mission

• Integrated within UBP’s Operations department, the Fees team manages the day to day application and collection of fees from clients’ accounts and market counterparties group wise. The team has an interdisciplinary role in a fast-paced environment : it supports the Front Office for fees queries and works in close collaboration with the other departments of the Asset and Wealth management divisions of UBP.

• Main responsibilities

• Its main missions are as follows:

• Create, amend and maintain the base fees schedules group wise.

• Set-up, amend and manage the clients’ fees exceptions.

• Set-up, amend and manage the brokers and other internal counterparties fees exceptions.

• Perform appropriate follow-up on outstanding fee setups or requests.

• Daily support to internal clients, including but not limited to Front Office, WM Business leads, Finance and other teams within the Operations department.

• Prepare and manage the quarterly fees billing, follow-up on quarterly billing tasks, including manual billing exceptions.

• Actively take part in the bank’s repricing initiatives, support WM leads on fees opportunities.

• Actively take part in other projects impacting the Fees team.

• Core competencies

• The successful candidate will possess the following skills:

• Analytical and problem solving skills: be at ease with numbers and larger datasets. Be able to think in “problem-action-results” terms.

• Flexibility: Be proactive and driven. Be able to adjust to urgent requests or shifting priorities, maange time effectively. Adjust decision-making in light of unforeseen circumstances.

• Client service ethic: Professional conduct with strong focus on client service, build lasting relationships with other departments of the group.

• Risk management : Review existing control framework to identify procedural loopholes or enhancement opportunities. Be able to raise concerns and propose mitigations or enhancement solutions. Be able to support audit requests, in coordination with the team’s supervisor or manager.

• Team spirit : Proactively help others and work for a common goal. Be open to others’ ideas, express opinion in a constructive way.

• Your Profile

• French and English speaking mandatory. Other languages is a plus.

• Preferrably knowledgeable in market finance : understands the various financial instruments, the trading and reconciliation flows as well as the custody chain.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office pack, specifically Microsoft Excel. Other VBA/Python/R skills is a plus.

• Others

• Swiss Residence

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• MISSIONE TEMPORARIA ( 6 MESE)

• Missione

• Integrato all'interno del dipartimento Operazioni UBP, il team di Fees gestisce l'applicazione giorno per giorno e la raccolta di tasse da account clienti e controparti di mercato gruppo saggi. Il team ha un ruolo interdisciplinare in un ambiente frenetico: supporta il Front Office per le richieste di tasse e lavora in stretta collaborazione con gli altri dipartimenti delle divisioni di gestione Asset e Wealth di UBP.

• Principali responsabilità

• Le sue principali missioni sono le seguenti:

• Creare, modificare e mantenere le spese di base programma gruppo saggio.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire le tasse dei clienti eccezioni.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire i broker e altre controparti interne tasse eccezioni.

• Eseguire il follow-up appropriato su impostazioni o richieste di pagamento eccezionali.

• Sostegno giornaliero a clienti interni, inclusi, ma non limitati a Front Office, WM Business, Finanza e altre squadre all'interno del reparto Operazioni.

• Preparare e gestire le commissioni trimestrali fatturazione, follow-up sulle attività di fatturazione trimestrale, comprese le eccezioni di fatturazione manuale.

• Partecipa attivamente alle iniziative di riformulazione della banca, supporto WM conduce alle opportunità di pagamento.

• Partecipa attivamente ad altri progetti che influenzano il team Fees.

• Competenze fondamentali

• Il candidato di successo possederà le seguenti competenze:

• Analitica e problem solving competenze: essere a proprio agio con numeri e dataset più grandi. Essere in grado di pensare in termini “problem-action-results”.

• Flessibilità: Sii proattivo e guidato. Essere in grado di adattarsi alle richieste urgenti o alle priorità di spostamento, maange il tempo in modo efficace. Regolare il processo decisionale alla luce di circostanze impreviste.

• Servizio clienti etico: condotta professionale con forte attenzione al servizio clienti, costruire relazioni durature con altri dipartimenti del gruppo.

• Gestione del rischio: rivedere il quadro di controllo esistente per identificare scappatoie procedurali o opportunità di miglioramento. Essere in grado di sollevare preoccupazioni e proporre mitigazioni o soluzioni di miglioramento. Essere in grado di sostenere le richieste di audit, in coordinamento con il supervisore del team o manager.

• Spirito di squadra: Proattivamente aiutare gli altri e lavorare per un obiettivo comune. Sii aperto alle idee altrui, esprimere l’opinione in modo costruttivo.

• Il tuo profilo

• Francese e inglese che parlano obbligatorio. Altre lingue sono un plus.

• Preferibilmente conoscibile nella finanza di mercato: comprende i vari strumenti finanziari, i flussi di negoziazione e riconciliazione e la catena di custodia.

• Proficiente con Microsoft Office pack, specificamente Microsoft Excel. Altre abilità VBA/Python/R sono un plus.

• Altri

• Residenza svizzera

• Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• VORÜBERTRAGUNG (6 Monate)

• Mission

• Integriert in die Operations-Abteilung von UBP verwaltet das Gebühren-Team die tägliche Anwendung und Erhebung von Gebühren von Kundenkonten und Gegenparteien. Das Team spielt in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld eine interdisziplinäre Rolle: Es unterstützt das Front Office bei Gebührenabfragen und arbeitet eng mit den anderen Abteilungen der Asset- und Wealth-Management-Divisionen der UBP zusammen.

• Erstellen, Ändern und Beibehalten der Basisgebührenpläne gruppenweise.

• Einrichtung, Änderung und Verwaltung der Gebührenausnahmen der Kunden.

• Einrichten, Ändern und Verwalten von Ausnahmen von den Gebühren für Broker und andere interne Gegenparteien.

• Führen Sie angemessene Folgemaßnahmen zu ausstehenden Gebühren-Setups oder Anfragen durch.

• Tägliche Unterstützung für interne Kunden, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Front Office, WM Business Leads, Finanzen und andere Teams innerhalb der Operations-Abteilung.

• Bereiten und verwalten Sie die vierteljährliche Gebührenabrechnung, Follow-up für vierteljährliche Abrechnungsaufgaben, einschließlich manueller Abrechnungsausnahmen.

• Nehmen Sie aktiv an den Repricing-Initiativen der Bank teil und unterstützen Sie WM-Leads bei Gebührenmöglichkeiten.

• Nehmen Sie aktiv an anderen Projekten teil, die sich auf das Gebührenteam auswirken.

• Kernkompetenzen

• Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird die folgenden Fähigkeiten besitzen:

• Analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten: Seien Sie mit Zahlen und größeren Datensätzen vertraut. Seien Sie in der Lage, in "Problem-Action-Ergebnisse" zu denken.

• Flexibilität: Seien Sie proaktiv und motiviert. In der Lage sein, sich an dringende Anfragen oder wechselnde Prioritäten anzupassen, Zeit effektiv zu verändern. Anpassung der Entscheidungsfindung an unvorhergesehene Umstände.

• Kundendienstethik: Professionelles Verhalten mit starkem Fokus auf Kundenservice, Aufbau dauerhafter Beziehungen zu anderen Abteilungen der Gruppe.

• Risikomanagement: Überprüfung des bestehenden Kontrollrahmens, um Verfahrenslücken oder Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren. In der Lage sein, Bedenken zu äußern und Minderungs- oder Verbesserungslösungen vorzuschlagen. In der Lage sein, Auditanfragen in Abstimmung mit dem Vorgesetzten oder Manager des Teams zu unterstützen.

• Teamgeist: Anderen proaktiv helfen und für ein gemeinsames Ziel arbeiten. Seien Sie offen für die Ideen anderer, äußern Sie Ihre Meinung konstruktiv.

• Ihr Profil

• Französisch und Englisch sprechen obligatorisch. Andere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• MISSION TEMPORAIRE (6 MOIS)

• Mission

• Intégrée au service des opérations de l'UBP, l'équipe des frais gère l'application quotidienne et la perception des frais auprès des clients. L'équipe a un rôle interdisciplinaire dans un environnement accéléré : elle soutient le Front Office pour les demandes de frais et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les autres départements des divisions Asset and Wealth Management d'UBP.

• Principales responsabilités

• Ses principales missions sont les suivantes :

• Créer, modifier et maintenir les barèmes des frais de base.

• Configurer, modifier et gérer les exceptions aux frais des clients.

• Mettre en place, modifier et gérer les courtiers et autres contreparties internes en cas d'exception aux frais.

• Effectuer un suivi approprié des configurations ou des demandes de frais en suspens.

• Soutien quotidien aux clients internes, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, aux directions générales, aux directions des affaires, aux finances et à d'autres équipes du service des opérations.

• Préparer et gérer la facturation trimestrielle, le suivi des tâches de facturation trimestrielle, y compris les exceptions à la facturation manuelle.

• Participer activement aux initiatives de la banque, soutenir WM mène sur les opportunités de frais.

• Participer activement à d'autres projets touchant l'équipe des frais.

• Compétences de base

• La candidate reçue possède les compétences suivantes :

• Compétences en analyse et résolution de problèmes : être à l'aise avec les nombres et les ensembles de données plus importants. Être capable de penser en termes de problèmes-action-résultats.

• Flexibilité : être proactif et motivé. Être en mesure de s'adapter aux demandes urgentes ou de changer de priorités, maange temps efficacement. Régler la prise de décision en fonction de circonstances imprévues.

• Éthique du service à la clientèle : conduite professionnelle axée sur le service à la clientèle, établissement de relations durables avec d'autres ministères du groupe.

• Gestion des risques : Examiner le cadre de contrôle existant pour cerner les lacunes ou les possibilités d'amélioration des procédures. Être en mesure de soulever des préoccupations et proposer des solutions d'atténuation ou d'amélioration. Être en mesure d'appuyer les demandes de vérification, en coordination avec le superviseur ou le gestionnaire de l'équipe.

jobs.description:
• Mission:

• As a Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities:

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Troubleshoot and improve AD replication, DNS, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

• Implement and enforce security policies, including password policies, account lockout policies, and auditing.

• Integrate Active Directory with other systems, such as Office 365, Azure AD, and third-party applications.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation of routine tasks and reporting

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans for Active Directory.

• Setting up and maintaining Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities.

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in:

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• PKI and certificat management

• SCCM

• Exchange 2019

• Powershell scripting

• MS Teams

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

• Intune

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Security engineer
jobs.description:
Mission
 Design, build, and operate secure-by-design controls and services that protect the Bank’s platforms, applications, and data. Implement and maintain security tools to prevent, detect, and respond to threats, ensuring resilience, reliability, and compliance with banking regulations.

Main responsibilities

• Engineer, deploy, and maintain security platforms and controls (PAM, DAM, CSPM, DLP, Vulnerability Management).

• Review application designs and verify compliance with security requirements; provide actionable guidance, identify gaps, and track remediation through to closure.

• Implement security-by-design and security-by-default patterns across infrastructure, applications, and data services.

• Perform operational duties for ticketing: triage, prioritize, and resolve security tickets; escalate and coordinate with platform and application teams;

• Define secure configuration baselines, and compliance checks.

• Support incident response lifecycle: containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident improvements; contribute to root cause analysis.

• Monitor cyber platform SLAs/KPIs (availability, performance, coverage, detection efficacy) and drive continuous improvement.

Your Profile

• Hands-on security engineer with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for automation and reliability.

• Able to translate security requirements into practical, scalable engineering solutions aligned to a regulated financial environment.

• Comfortable with modern platform tooling.

Education

• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.

Experience Technical skills

• Mid to Senior: 3–7+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Security Operations Engineering, or Secure Platform Engineering.

Languages

• French : Fluent

• English : Strong advantage

Personal skills

• Self-motivated with ownership mindset; able to operate strategically while remaining hands-on when needed.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate technical risk into business impact.

• Strong critical thinking, analytical problem-solving, and decision-making under pressure.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex, multi-department initiatives.

• High integrity, resilience, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Others

• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Implementare e mantenere strumenti di sicurezza per prevenire, rilevare e rispondere alle minacce, garantire resilienza, affidabilità e conformità alle normative bancarie.

Principali responsabilità

• Ingegnere, distribuire e mantenere piattaforme e controlli di sicurezza (PAM, DAM, CSPM, DLP, Vulnerability Management).

• Eseguire i dazi operativi per la biglietteria: triage, priorità e risolvere i biglietti di sicurezza; escalare e coordinare con i team di piattaforma e applicazioni;

• Definire le basi di configurazione sicure e i controlli di conformità.

• Supporto ciclo di vita di risposta incidente: contenimento, eradicazione, recupero e miglioramenti post-incidenti; contribuire all'analisi di causa radice.

jobs.description:
Job description
 Assistant Relationship Manager

NAME:

CORPORATE JOB TITLE:
 Assistant Relationship Manager

POSITION:

REPORTS TO:
 Branch Manager

SENIOR MANAGEMENT FUNCTION (YES/NO):
 No

PRESCRIBED RESPONSBILITY:
 N/A

MATERIAL RISK TAKER (YES/NO):
 No

CERTIFIED (YES/NO):
 Yes

CERTIFIED FUNCTIONS:
 Client Dealing

LAST UPDATED:
 June 2026

Main Responsibilities
 The Primary responsibility of the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) is the day-to-day management of the Bank’s relationships with Wealth Management clients. The ARM will utilise their in-depth knowledge of the Bank’s products and services to understand the needs and requirements of the client. The ARM should be the primary point of contact for the client ensuring a joined-up approach to client coverage with the RM. The ARM must have the required skill set to be a delegate on behalf of the RM when they are unavailable. The role requires a high level of client service and to act accordingly in the clients’ best interests, in a regulatory compliant and commercial manner.
 Role Duties

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients whilst handling day-to-day correspondence with them and their representatives

• Multi-task and use effective time management skills to prioritise short terms tasks while simultaneously managing longer-term projects. With the ability to work in a highly pressurised environment, whilst meeting both client and internal deadlines

• Handling data requests from clients and stakeholders within the firm

• Full ownership of cash management solutions

• Executing and ensuring settlement of client orders (FX, Cash, Equities, Fixed Income etc.)

• Processing client account opening from inception to completion, including gathering all necessary KYC and AML documentation

• Assisting with the completion of event driven and periodic reviews

• Preparing credit and loan requests including general administration of credit facilities

• Liaising with other UBP branches for cross-booked accounts

• Diarise and prepare for client meetings with the Relationship Manager – liaise with portfolio managers, wealth planners and the credit team prior to coordinate attendance, where appropriate. Review past meeting notes, identify areas to discuss and if any information is required from the clients to update our records

• Assist the Relationship Manager with the preparation of Investment Suitability Reviews and Credit proposals for banker sign off, documenting client circumstances appropriately, with the ability to identify high risk and vulnerable clients and support them to required standard

• Keeping the Relationship Manager up-to-date with all client related information and delegating tasks accordingly

• Initiate projects to enhance existing processes and contribute ideas for improvements to the team and to management

• Support the Relationship Manager in revenue generation from existing and potential clients by identifying new opportunities, whilst at all times being mindful of, and adhering to the principles of Treating Customers Fairly. It is expected to fully understand the clients and their circumstances

• Act as a point of contact for Relationship Managers when they are away from the office or on annual leave

• Actively assisting the Relationship Manager in developing client relationships to their full business potential trough a detailed knowledge of the client

• Maintain excellent professional standards through appropriate training and development, keeping up to date with developments in the marketplace

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of the Bank’s products and services

• To adhere to the Bank’s Policies and Procedures and act in accordance with the regulatory requirements and standards under the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Prudential Conduct Authority (PRA) and the Guernsey Financial Services Commission (GFSC). To comply with the principles, codes and practices for approved persons and the rules of the FCA, PRA and GFSC.

The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management.

Committee Membership

• None

Conduct Rules
 This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) and Guernsey Financial Services Commission (GFSC) individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, PRA, GFSC and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly; 5. To observe proper standards of market conduct; and 6. To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
 Knowledge, Skills & Experience Preferred Qualifications:
 Possess a Commercial/Finance/banking-oriented qualification or equivalent experience

Skills and Knowledge:

• Experience of working as an assistant in private banking or in another client facing front office role

• A good understanding of the private client industry and its products

• You understand and enjoy dealing with sophisticated private investors

• You are outgoing, client focused and understand what it means to deliver a high level of service

• You are a strong team player who is highly organised, logical in your approach, have an eye for detail, and you are able to handle many parallel tasks

• You are a self-starter who is able to identify and solve problems independently

• Strong business development aptitude with the ability to spot opportunities for business growth through existing client circumstances

• You have a natural passion to deliver great client outcomes

• You are able to solve complex queries through cross team collaboration

jobs.title: Database-Oriented Analyst/Developer (Oracle) – Banking Sector
jobs.description:
Mission

• Participate in workshops to capture functional/technical requirements and translate them into clear design documents for ODS changes and interfaces.

• Design, implement, and enhance Oracle PL/SQL objects (packages, procedures, views) within the ODS and across upstream (Core Banking) and downstream client application interfaces, emphasizing maintainability (clean modular design, clear naming, code reviews), robust observability (structured logging with audit trail in mind), and operability (standardized error handling and troubleshooting runbooks) to support reliable production operations.

• Create and modify UNIX KornShell (ksh) scripts to orchestrate multi-timezone batch jobs and data workflows.

• Coordinate delivery with onshore and offshore team members; align with architectural guidelines and interface contracts.

• Maintain and improve existing database artifacts, ensuring performance, stability, and reliability in production.

• Communicate with adjacent systems across the bank’s information system to ensure end-to-end data consistency and integrity.

• Provide technical support, troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and manage go-lives and production support.

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate documentation, specification drafting, and knowledge sharing where appropriate.

• Document APIs/interfaces, runbooks, functional and technical specifications to build organizational knowledge.

Key Qualifications

• 7–15 years of experience as an Oracle-focused analyst/developer supporting production systems in complex environments.

• Expert PL/SQL skills, including performance tuning and robust error handling.

• Proficiency with UNIX scripting (KornShell ksh or similar) for operational automation and batch orchestration.

• Experience eliciting requirements and producing functional and technical specifications aligned with architecture standards.

• Hands-on experience operating and supporting production data platforms (deployments, incident response, stability and performance improvements).

• Proven collaboration with business analysts, architects, and development teams across regions and time zones.

• Familiarity with multi-region, multi-timezone batch processing strategies in banking or similar regulated domains.

• Ability to leverage AI as a productivity tool for documentation and development specifications.

• Strong understanding of secure software and data handling practices in financial services.

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of ODS design patterns and file and event-driven ingestion from core banking systems.

• Exposure to downstream integrations and additional RDBMS (e.g., Sybase IQ, MS SQL Server) through batches

• Experience with CI/CD for database changes and schema versioning

• Familiarity with interface governance, API or messaging integration patterns.
 Experience in large-scale banking transformation programs (multi-entity, multi-region).

Mindset & Soft Skills

• Ownership mentality with a bias for clear, pragmatic solutions under production constraints.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; ability to debug complex batch/data issues.

• Clear communication and effective collaboration with business, architecture, and development teams.

• Knowledge-sharing mindset and commitment to high-quality documentation.

• Organized, detail-oriented, and dependable in production support contexts.

Our Tech Environment

• Databases: Oracle 19c+ (primary ODS), Sybase IQ (replicate).

• Scripting: UNIX KornShell (ksh) or similar. Acting as an interface with a scheduling software

• Data Domain: Operational Data Store fed by Core Banking events; gateway to Wealth Management and Operations applications.

• Processes: Requirements workshops; architectural governance; coordinated onshore/offshore delivery.

• Productivity: AI-assisted documentation/specification workflows.

• Tooling & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Git and CICD

Documentation & Governance

• Draft functional specifications validated with business and functional architecture.

• Draft technical specifications validated with technical architecture and development teams.

• Maintain runbooks, deployment guides, and knowledge base entries to support ongoing operations and onboarding.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to contribute to a critical bank-wide transformation of the operational data platform.

• Collaboration with business analysts, architects, and development teams across regions and time zones.

• Professional development and training support, including AI enablement.

• Stable environment with clear impact on core banking data flows.

Location

• Office location : Geneva

• Swiss Residency: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
