jobs.title: Documentum Developer (Consultant)
jobs.description:
• Mission
 We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Consultant to support an electronic content management (ECM) migration between two banking information systems. Our mission is to deliver a secure, timely, and compliant migration by assessing counterparty data, aligning data semantics, and operating robust integration processes. As a consultant you’ll design and run migration workflows, coordinate with business and technical teams from both organizations, and ensure high-quality outcomes—with a pragmatic, production-focused approach. Experience using AI as a productivity tool is a plus.

• Main responsibilities

• Assist Business and IT ECM teams to plan and execute the migration of content and metadata from one bank’s information system to the target bank’s system.

• Organize and lead data mapping workshops with business units; capture requirements and align data semantics across both banks.

• Conduct system assessments using input from domain business lines to evaluate counterparty data, identify integration challenges, and propose remediation strategies.

• Design, implement, and operate ETL processes and migration pipelines to move content and metadata into target ECM systems in a timely manner; leverage FME Migration Tool where applicable.

• Execute migration tasks hands-on, coordinating cutover and post-migration stabilization activities.

• Emphasize maintainability (modular, well-structured migration components), observability (structured logging, metrics, traceability), and operability (standardized error handling and troubleshooting runbooks) across the migration lifecycle.

• Ensure data quality and compliance through reconciliation checks, consistency validations, and regulatory controls; resolve discrepancies with stakeholders.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to align integration goals and manage expectations across business and IT.

• Document data mappings, functional and technical specifications, runbooks, and operational procedures to enable IT–business alignment and knowledge transfer.

• Ramp up quickly on both organizations’ systems and processes; contribute to cross-team collaboration.

• Your Profile

• Proven experience delivering ECM/content/data migrations in complex, regulated environments (preferably banking/financial services).

• Deep knowledge of Documentum architecture and administration, including:
• D2, Content Server, JMS, API, DFS, DFC, DqMan

• Captiva / InputAccel / Intelligent Capture platform knowledge

• Strong ETL design and implementation skills for content and metadata migrations; experience with reconciliation, rollback strategies, and performance considerations.

• Knowledge of the FME Migration Tool is a strong plus.

• Proficient in Java development (e.g., Eclipse) and familiar with DevOps principles for packaging, deployment, and CI integration.

• Understanding of Documentum security models (user roles, ACLs, access controls) and compliance requirements related to content management.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills; ability to translate business needs into precise data mappings and technical specifications.

• Fluent in English; fast learner able to integrate quickly with both companies’ business and technical teams.

• Ability to leverage AI tools as a productivity aid for documentation and specification tasks.
 Nice to Have

• Experience using AI to streamline migration documentation, mapping proposals, and quality checks.

• Integration experience between ECM and enterprise systems (e.g., APIs, messaging, downstream archives/records).

• Familiarity with data governance and regulatory frameworks for content retention and privacy (e.g., GDPR, records retention).

• Performance tuning and batch window planning for large-scale migrations.

• Knowledge of additional ECM migration utilities/tools.

Mindset & Soft Skills

• Ownership mentality with a bias for clean, pragmatic solutions and timely delivery.

• Strong problem-solving skills; methodical approach to debugging integration and data quality issues.

• Clear, empathetic communication and stakeholder management across business and IT.

• Organized, documentation-driven, and attentive to security and compliance.

• Collaborative, able to coordinate across multiple teams and time zones.

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Credit Structuring Officer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Mission
 As a Credit Structuring Officer you will support the Luxembourg-based Credit Structuring Team reporting to the Senior Credit Structuring Manager. The team provides support to the front-office to face any client request related to credits by setting up the best solution according to the Bank internal procedures and risk appetite.
 Main Duties

• Structure tailor-made financing solutions for private banking clients, including Lombard loans, mortgage loans, insurance-backed lending and other secured financing solutions, in compliance with the Bank’s internal policies and procedures, applicable regulations and relevant legal requirements.

• Advise Relationship Managers on optimal financing structures, pricing, collateral packages and credit terms.

• Perform comprehensive credit analysis, including the assessment of repayment capacity, collateral quality, legal structure, concentration risks and the overall client risk profile.

• Prepare, review and present credit applications to the relevant approval authorities (Local Credit Committee, Group Credit Committee, Board Credit Committee, etc.).

• Draft, review and negotiate credit documentation, including term sheets, loan agreements, amendments, security documentation and side letters.

• Coordinate complex financing transactions with internal stakeholders (Legal, Compliance, Credit Administration, Operations, Finance, Tax) and external advisers (law firms, notaries, valuers, insurance companies and other service providers).

• Conduct periodic reviews of existing credit facilities, reassess clients’ creditworthiness, collateral adequacy and covenant compliance, and prepare recommendations for the relevant approval authorities where required.

• Identify and escalate emerging credit risks, recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures and contribute to maintaining a sound and consistent credit risk framework.

• Participate in the development, review and continuous improvement of lending standards, templates and internal procedures.

Technical Skills

• University degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration.

• Minimum five years of experience in credit risk or private banking lending.

• Good knowledge of lending products, particularly Lombard and mortgage financing.

• Solid understanding of credit risk assessment, financial analysis and collateral valuation.

• Good knowledge of legal documentation relating to financing and security interests.

Personal Skills

• Strong analytical thinking and sound judgement.

• High attention to detail and accuracy.

• Proactive, solution-oriented and pragmatic mindset.

• High level of integrity, discretion and confidentiality.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments.

Languages

• Fluent English and French (written and spoken).

• Additional languages are considered an asset.

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks.
 By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
 UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
 In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

jobs.title: Anonymization Developer
jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, implement, and operate services and tooling for enterprise-grade data anonymization and protection across production databases.

• Develop and maintain REST API backends enabling anonymization workflows and integration with upstream/downstream systems.

• Build automation and operational scripts in PowerShell and Bash to deploy, monitor, and manage DAP services.

• Contribute to backend services and utilities in Java and/or C# with clean, testable, and secure code.

• Integrate with and support multiple database engines (MongoDB, MS SQL Server, Oracle), including schema discovery, profiling, and rules application.

• Collaborate with security, data governance, and application teams to define and enforce data masking/tokenization standards and policies.

• Implement observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and CI/CD pipelines for reliable delivery and operations.

• Troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive continuous improvements in scalability, reliability, and performance.

• Document APIs, runbooks, and operational procedures; contribute to knowledge sharing and onboarding materials.

Key Qualifications

• Strong, practical experience building and operating REST API backends (designing endpoints, versioning, authentication/authorization, performance tuning, resilience).

• Hands-on programming in at least two of the following: Java, C#; and scripting proficiency in PowerShell and Bash.

• Solid database fundamentals and hands-on experience with:
• MongoDB (collections, indexing, aggregation, performance basics)

• Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL, schema design, indexing strategies)

• Oracle Database (PL/SQL fundamentals, performance considerations)

• Experience integrating backends with databases securely (connection handling, secrets management, least privilege).

• Familiarity with data anonymization/masking/tokenization concepts and patterns.

• Good understanding of secure software development practices (Kerberos, OWASP, input validation, secrets handling, TLS, logging without leakage).

• Comfortable with CI/CD tools and version control; experience with automated testing and code quality practices.

Nice to Have

• Experience with enterprise data masking/tokenization tools or libraries.

• Knowledge of data governance and privacy frameworks (GDPR, data minimization, DPIA).

• Exposure to event-driven architectures, message queues, or ETL/ELT pipelines.

• Containerization and orchestration (eg Docker/Podman, OpenShift) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Ansible).

• Observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, OpenTelemetry).

• Performance profiling and capacity planning for API services and databases.

• Experience in regulated environments (banking/financial services).

Mindset & Soft Skills

• Ownership mentality with a bias for clean, pragmatic solutions.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex, distributed issues.

• Clear communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Attention to detail in security and compliance.

Our Tech Environment

• Languages: Java, C#

• Scripting: PowerShell, Bash

• Databases: MongoDB, MS SQL Server, Oracle

• APIs: REST-first design, OpenAPI/Swagger, OAuth2/OIDC, Kerberos

• DevOps: Git-based workflows, CI/CD in Azure Dev Ops, containers, observability

What We Offer

• Opportunity to shape a bank-wide platform critical to data protection and privacy.

• Collaborative environment with security, data, and platform engineers.

• Professional development, certifications, and training support.

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with industry standards.

• Flexible work practices in a modern engineering environment.

• Location
• Swiss Residence : Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, implement, and operate backend services and APIs using Java (17/11/8), Spring (4/5), and Spring Boot (2.x/3.x).

• Build and maintain REST and SOAP APIs; manage HTTP layers and API specifications using OpenAPI / Swagger.

• Develop supporting front-end/admin consoles in Vue.js or Angular where relevant to platform operations.

• Integrate with Oracle and MS SQL Server using JPA/Hibernate; contribute SQL/PL-SQL and manage schema changes via Liquibase.

• Implement CI/CD pipelines (YAML-based) with Maven and Git, including quality gates and test automation.

• Apply secure authentication and authorization patterns (Kerberos, OAuth2/OIDC); follow AppSec best practices (OWASP, input validation, secrets handling).

• Contribute to test strategy and automation (unit, integration, BDD/ATDD with JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber; Jest on frontend).

• Support production operations: troubleshoot incidents, analyze performance, and drive reliability improvements.

• Document APIs, architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures; track work in JIRA.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to align software architecture with business goals and platform standards.

Key Qualifications

• 7–15 years of professional software engineering experience; proven track record supporting production systems.

• Strong backend development with:
• Java (from 8 to the latest LTS being the target for all apps)

• Spring 4/5 and Spring Boot 2.x/3.x

• REST and SOAP API design; HTTP layer fundamentals; OpenAPI standard

• Frontend exposure with Vue.js or Angular for operational/admin UIs.

• Databases: Oracle and MS SQL Server, with hands-on experience in:
• JPA/Hibernate

• SQL, DB performance fundamentals

• Liquibase for schema migrations

• PL/SQL (beginner level, <2 years)

• CI/CD and DevOps practices:
• Git, Maven

• Pipeline management in YAML

• Test automation integration in pipelines

• Security and authentication:
• Kerberos and OAuth2/OIDC

• Good knowledge of AppSec (SQL injection, XSS, RCE) and secure coding practices

• Testing practices:
• JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber (BDD/ATDD)

• Jest for frontend unit tests

• Note: Team does not practice strict TDD; emphasis is on pragmatic, automated testing

• Software architecture proficiency and ability to document clearly.

• Languages: Fluent in English. French is useful.

• Soft skills: Organized, reliable in production support, able to communicate clearly and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

• Rule engines and BPMN tools (e.g., Drools; beginner <2 years).

• Node.js for tooling or auxiliary services.

• E2E testing experience (Cypress, Protractor, Selenium WebDriver, PlayWright).

• API/Load testing (JMeter) — Note: Tool may not be available in current environment.

• Familiarity with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Checkmarx or Fortify).

• Strong sensitivity to code quality (Sonar rules/Clean Code) and OWASP guidelines.

• Experience in regulated environments (banking/financial services).

Mindset & Soft Skills

• Ownership mentality and practical problem-solving under production constraints.

• Clear communication and effective collaboration with developers, QA, and security.

• Attention to detail in security, documentation, and code quality.

• Pragmatic approach to process; comfort operating without full agile maturity.

Our Tech Environment

• Languages: Java (17/11/8); Node.js [Optional]

• Frameworks: Spring 4/5, Spring Boot 2.x/3.x

• Frontend: Vue.js, Angular; Jest for unit tests

• Databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server; JPA/Hibernate; SQL/PL-SQL (beginner); Liquibase

• APIs: REST and SOAP; HTTP layers; OpenAPI/Swagger; Kerberos; OAuth2/OIDC

• DevOps: Git, Maven; CI/CD pipelines (YAML); Test Automation; Sonar/Clean Code

• Tools/Process: JIRA; BDD/ATDD with Cucumber

• AI: internal framework accessible from the dev platform

• What We Offer

• Opportunity to build and operate production services with real impact in a leading bank.

• Collaboration with experienced application, platform, and security engineers.

• Professional development and training support.

• Pragmatic work practices focused on delivery and reliability.

• Location

• Mandatory Swiss Residency close to Geneva

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
